full_list.title_en: Magnons and excitons from Bethe-Salpeter equation and its application to graphene-based magnets
full_list.title_zh: Bethe-Salpeter 方程中的磁振子和激子及其在石墨烯基磁体中的应用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32847v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the recent isolation of two-dimensional semiconducting magnetic materials, the theoretical study of spin-flip collective excitations (magnons) along with spin-conserving electron-hole bound pairs (excitons) has become particularly relevant. Describing both types of quasiparticles within the same theoretical framework is possible, in principle, but the well-established many-body formalism for the calculation of excitons, based on the intertwined Bethe-Salpeter and Hedin's equations, is not satisfactory for magnons, since the usual approximations produce a spurious gapped Goldstone mode. Here, we show that excitons and magnons can be computed on the same footing under the same Bethe-Salpeter formalism, while respecting the gapless Goldstone mode for magnons. We demonstrate how this can be achieved through the evaluation of the full Bethe-Salpeter equation, beyond the Tamm-Dancoff approximation in model Hamiltonians. As an example, we apply it to ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic graphene, faithfully represented by the extended Hubbard model. Our results clarify the roles of on-site and non-local interactions in exciton and magnon appearance and identify consistency requirements relevant to extending the approach to first-principles calculations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 随着最近二维半导体磁性材料的分离，自旋翻转集体激发（磁振子）以及自旋守恒电子空穴束缚对（激子）的理论研究变得尤为重要。原则上，在同一理论框架内描述两种类型的准粒子是可能的，但基于相互交织的 Bethe-Salpeter 和 Hedin 方程的用于计算激子的成熟多体形式对于磁振子来说并不令人满意，因为通常的近似会产生虚假的有隙戈德斯通模式。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 随着最近二维半导体磁性材料的分离，自旋翻转集体激发（磁振子）以及自旋守恒电子空穴束缚对（激子）的理论研究变得尤为重要。原则上，在同一理论框架内描述两种类型的准粒子是可能的，但基于相互交织的 Bethe-Salpeter 和 Hedin 方程的用于计算激子的成熟多体形式对于磁振子来说并不令人满意，因为通常的近似会产生虚假的有隙戈德斯通模式。在这里，我们证明了激子和磁振子可以在相同的 Bethe-Salpeter 形式主义下以相同的基础进行计算，同时尊重磁振子的无间隙戈德斯通模式。我们演示了如何通过评估完整的 Bethe-Salpeter 方程来实现这一点，超越模型哈密顿量中的 Tamm-Dancoff 近似。作为一个例子，我们将其应用于铁磁和反铁磁石墨烯，由扩展的哈伯德模型忠实地表示。我们的结果阐明了现场和非局域相互作用在激子和磁振子外观中的作用，并确定了与扩展第一性原理计算方法相关的一致性要求。

full_list.title_en: Quantum Landau Lifshitz Gilbert equation in ferromagnetic conductors and magnetic insulators
full_list.title_zh: 铁磁导体和磁绝缘体中的量子 Landau Lifshitz Gilbert 方程
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the microscopic origin of magnetic damping is essential for describing magnetization dynamics in nanoscale magnetic systems. In this work, we develop a microscopic framework to derive Gilbert damping terms from specific interactions in ferromagnetic conductors and magnetic insulators. In ferromagnetic conductors, magnetic damping is dominated by the s d exchange interaction between the localized magnetic moments and the itinerant electrons, which is effectively equivalent to an electronmagnon interaction. From the spin diffusion equation and the spin transfer torque therein, we obtain the corresponding quantum LLG equation. In magnetic insulators, where free electrons are absent, spin phonon interactions become the primary source of the damping.Starting from an effective spin phonon interaction and using linear response theory, we derive a quantum LLG equation with a Gilbert damping tensor analytically. Our results demonstrate that different microscopic interactions lead to qualitatively different structures of magnetic damping. Instead of being described by a universal scalar parameter, Gilbert damping can exhibit spatial dependence and tensorial characteristics determined by the underlying microscopic interactions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 了解磁阻尼的微观起源对于描述纳米级磁系统中的磁化动力学至关重要。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个微观框架，从铁磁导体和磁绝缘体的特定相互作用中推导出吉尔伯特阻尼项。在铁磁导体中，磁阻尼主要由局域磁矩和巡回电子之间的 sd 交换相互作用决定，这实际上相当于电子磁振子相互作用。由自旋扩散方程和其中的自旋转移矩，我们得到相应的量子LLG方程。在不存在自由电子的磁绝缘体中，自旋声子相互作用成为阻尼的主要来源。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 了解磁阻尼的微观起源对于描述纳米级磁系统中的磁化动力学至关重要。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个微观框架，从铁磁导体和磁绝缘体的特定相互作用中推导出吉尔伯特阻尼项。在铁磁导体中，磁阻尼主要由局域磁矩和巡回电子之间的 sd 交换相互作用决定，这实际上相当于电子磁振子相互作用。由自旋扩散方程和其中的自旋转移矩，我们得到相应的量子LLG方程。在不存在自由电子的磁绝缘体中，自旋声子相互作用成为阻尼的主要来源。从有效的自旋声子相互作用出发，利用线性响应理论，我们分析推导了带有吉尔伯特阻尼张量的量子LLG方程。我们的结果表明，不同的微观相互作用会导致磁阻尼结构的性质不同。吉尔伯特阻尼不是用通用标量参数来描述，而是可以表现出由潜在的微观相互作用决定的空间依赖性和张量特征。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《铁磁导体和磁绝缘体中的量子 Landau Lifshitz Gilbert 方程》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Robustness of Skyrmion-Mediated Magnetization Switching in Perpendicular Magnetic Tunnel Junctions (p-MTJs) to Material Disorder and Elevated Temperature
full_list.title_zh: 垂直磁隧道结 (p-MTJ) 中斯格明子介导的磁化转变对材料无序和高温的鲁棒性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transient-skyrmion mediated voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy (VCMA) switching is a fast and energy efficient way to magnetization reversal, but its reliability under realistic material disorder and thermal fluctuations remain unclear. In this work, we use stochastic micromagnetic simulations of a 100 nm perpendicular magnetic tunnel junction to study switching reliability under grain-scale variations in Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, easy-axis orientation, and intergrain exchange coupling. We find that switching remains robust under moderate disorder, with 100% switching observed in 10⁴ stochastic simulations after pulse width optimization at both 300 K and 350 K. Increasing the temperature from 300 to 350 K shifts the optimum VCMA pulse width from ~475 to ~450 ps, indicating that an apparent reduction in switching probability at a fixed pulse duration can be primarily due to pulse detuning. In contrast, strong easy-axis disorder reduces the maximum switching probability even after pulse-width optimization, indicating degradation of the switching dynamics. We further show that, under strong easy-axis disorder a transient skyrmion still forms while the subsequent post-pulse dynamics fails to complete the magnetization reversal. Our study therefore establishes the distinction between recoverable reliability due to timing shifts and permanent disorder-induced degradation that simply cannot be recovered by pulse re-tuning. Finally, for no disorders but at room temperature, 100% switching is observed with 10⁶ stochastic simulations with correct pulse shaping.
full_list.abstract_zh: 瞬态斯格明子介导的压控磁各向异性（VCMA）切换是一种快速且节能的磁化反转方式，但其在现实材料无序和热波动下的可靠性仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们使用 100 nm 垂直磁隧道结的随机微磁模拟来研究 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用、垂直磁各向异性、易轴取向和晶间交换耦合中晶粒尺度变化下的开关可靠性。我们发现，在中度无序情况下，开关仍然保持稳健，在 300 K 和 350 K 的脉冲宽度优化后，在 10⁴ 随机模拟中观察到 100% 的开关。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 瞬态斯格明子介导的压控磁各向异性（VCMA）切换是一种快速且节能的磁化反转方式，但其在现实材料无序和热波动下的可靠性仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们使用 100 nm 垂直磁隧道结的随机微磁模拟来研究 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用、垂直磁各向异性、易轴取向和晶间交换耦合中晶粒尺度变化下的开关可靠性。我们发现，在中度无序情况下，开关仍然保持稳健，在 300 K 和 350 K 的脉冲宽度优化后，在 10⁴ 随机模拟中观察到 100% 的开关。将温度从 300 K 增加到 350 K，将最佳 VCMA 脉冲宽度从约 475 ps 移动到约 450 ps，这表明固定脉冲持续时间下开关概率的明显降低可能主要是由于脉冲失谐。相反，即使在脉冲宽度优化之后，强的易轴无序也会降低最大开关概率，这表明开关动态性能下降。我们进一步表明，在强易轴无序下，瞬态斯格明子仍然形成，而随后的脉冲后动力学未能完成磁化反转。因此，我们的研究建立了由于时序偏移而导致的可恢复可靠性与无法通过脉冲重新调谐来恢复的永久无序引起的退化之间的区别。最后，对于没有任何紊乱但在室温下的情况，通过 10⁶ 随机模拟和正确的脉冲整形观察到 100% 的切换。

full_list.title_en: Discrete WKB approach to density profiles in inhomogeneous two-band free-fermion chains
full_list.title_zh: 非均匀双带自由费米链密度分布的离散 WKB 方法
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32710v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We extend the discrete WKB method to one-dimensional bipartite tight-binding chains of free fermions with slowly varying hopping amplitudes and on-site potentials. We focus on the inhomogeneous Rice-Mele model, suggesting possible experimental realizations thereof in optical superlattices. We derive explicit semiclassical expressions for the single-particle wave functions and density of states, as well as the sublattice-resolved local particle densities and filling fraction at arbitrary Fermi energy. In particular, we show that the WKB density profiles agree with those obtained from the local-density approximation. We analyze the spatial dependence of the local band edges and its consequences for the global spectral structure, and clarify the role played by the phase-space topology in determining the Bohr-Sommerfeld quantization conditions. Finally, we illustrate our results with two representative examples: a homogeneous Rice-Mele chain subject to a harmonic trap and a fully inhomogeneous chain containing a domain wall.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们将离散 WKB 方法扩展到具有缓慢变化的跳跃幅度和现场电位的自由费米子的一维二分紧束缚链。我们关注非均匀 Rice-Mele 模型，提出了其在光学超晶格中可能的实验实现。我们推导出单粒子波函数和态密度的显式半经典表达式，以及任意费米能量下亚晶格解析的局部粒子密度和填充分数。特别是，我们表明 WKB 密度分布与从局部密度近似获得的分布一致。我们分析了局部能带边缘的空间依赖性及其对全局光谱结构的影响，并阐明了相空间拓扑在确定玻尔-索末菲量化条件中所起的作用。

full_list.title_en: Laser-induced metastable (anti-)skyrmion states with higher-order topological charge
full_list.title_zh: 具有高阶拓扑电荷的激光诱导亚稳态（反）斯格明子态
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.13112v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ultrafast creation and manipulation of topologically non-trivial spin objects promises significant potential for spintronic applications. Here, we demonstrate laser-induced nucleation of skyrmions and antiskyrmions with topological charge up to |Q|=3 from the saturated magnetization state of a Co/Ni-multilayer which does not intrinsically host a skyrmionic ground state. The resulting configuration of spin objects thus constitutes a metastable, thermodynamically hidden magnetic state. We control the number and type of spin objects by the excitation fluence and the external out-of-plane magnetic field.
full_list.abstract_zh: 拓扑非平凡自旋物体的超快创建和操纵为自旋电子学应用带来了巨大潜力。在这里，我们演示了激光诱导斯格明子和反斯格明子的成核，其拓扑电荷从本质上不具有斯格明子基态的 Co/Ni 多层的饱和磁化状态达到 |Q|=3。由此产生的自旋物体的结构构成了亚稳态、热力学隐藏的磁态。我们通过激发注量和外部面外磁场来控制自旋物体的数量和类型。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《具有高阶拓扑电荷的激光诱导亚稳态（反）斯格明子态》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Tuning the magnetic properties of Kitaev materials via the antiferromagnetic proximity effect: Novel phases and application to an α-RuCl₃/MnPS₃ bilayer
full_list.title_zh: 通过反铁磁邻近效应调节 Kitaev 材料的磁性：新型相及其在 α-RuCl₃/MnPS₃ 双层中的应用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.22310v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In recent years, the increasing level of control over van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures has opened new routes to tune the properties of quantum materials. Motivated by these developments, we examine the potential consequences of interfacing a Kitaev honeycomb magnet, such as α-RuCl₃, with a nearly lattice-matched vdW antiferromagnet. By combining perturbation theory, exact diagonalization, and a classical energy-minimization method, we show that an effective staggered magnetic field originating from the vdW antiferromagnet can drive a monolayer of a Kitaev material into various novel phases, including an antichiral Kitaev spin liquid, a nonmagnetic nematic phase, and different types of skyrmion crystals. We then apply first-principles simulations to assess the prospect of concretely realizing this setup in a heterobilayer of α-RuCl₃ and the easy-axis antiferromagnet MnPS₃.
full_list.abstract_zh: 近年来，对范德华（vdW）异质结构的控制水平不断提高，为调节量子材料的性能开辟了新途径。受这些发展的推动，我们研究了将 Kitaev 蜂窝磁体（例如 α-RuCl₃）与几乎晶格匹配的 vdW 反铁磁体连接的潜在后果。通过结合微扰理论、精确对角化和经典能量最小化方法，我们证明源自 vdW 反铁磁体的有效交错磁场可以将单层 Kitaev 材料驱动成各种新颖的相，包括反手性 Kitaev 自旋液体、非磁性向列相和不同类型的斯格明子晶体。

full_list.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 26 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03495-x Two-dimensional altermagnets hold promise for next-generation spintronics but remain difficult to synthesize. full_list.title_en: Deterministic Ground-State Search in a Spatial Photonic Ising Machine by Phase Retrieval
full_list.title_zh: 通过相位检索在空间光子发射机中进行确定性基态搜索
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.16474v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A spatial photonic Ising machine (SPIM) solves large-scale combinatorial optimization problems by computing the Ising Hamiltonian through an optical Fourier transform. However, the ground-state search relies on annealing, in which spins are optimized stochastically and sequentially. We propose a ground-state search based on phase retrieval (PR), in which all spins are updated simultaneously and deterministically. Imposing an amplitude constraint in the Fourier plane guides the modulated phase distribution, which encodes the spin configuration, toward the optimal solution. We numerically demonstrate that the proposed scheme reaches the ground state of rank-one Ising Hamiltonians with 10⁴ spins in a single iteration for all trials. Moreover, a radial rearrangement of the amplitudes and an appropriately designed target pattern alleviate search stagnation and improve the optimization of spin configurations. The collective and deterministic spin update by phase retrieval enables a fast ground-state search for large-scale combinatorial optimization.
full_list.abstract_zh: 空间光子伊辛机 (SPIM) 通过光学傅立叶变换计算伊辛哈密顿量来解决大规模组合优化问题。然而，基态搜索依赖于退火，其中自旋被随机且连续地优化。我们提出了一种基于相位检索（PR）的基态搜索，其中所有自旋都同时且确定性地更新。在傅立叶平面中施加幅度约束可以引导编码自旋配置的调制相位分布走向最佳解决方案。我们通过数值证明，所提出的方案在所有试验的单次迭代中达到 10⁴ 自旋的一级伊辛哈密顿量的基态。此外，振幅的径向重新排列和适当设计的目标图案减轻了搜索停滞并改善了自旋配置的优化。

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《通过相位检索在空间光子发射机中进行确定性基态搜索》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Spectroscopic, Light-Harvesting, and Quantum Mechanical Studies of a TDMIM·BF 4 Ionic Liquid Crystal-ZnO Cluster Hybrid for Dye-Sensitized Solar Cells
full_list.title_zh: 用于染料敏化太阳能电池的 TDMIM·BF 4 离子液晶-ZnO簇杂化物的光谱、光捕获和量子力学研究
full_list.abstract: Context- The present study reports a comprehensive theoretical investigation of the spectroscopic, light-harvesting, and quantum mechanical properties of a novel hybrid system consisting the ionic liquid crystal (ILC) 1-tetradecyl-3-methylimidazolium tetrafluoroborate (TDMIM·BF₄, C₁₄MIM·BF₄) and ZnO clusters. The hybrid network architecture combines the electronic properties of the ILC with the semiconducting characteristics of ZnO, with the aim of improving the performance of dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs). Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations were performed to investigate the structural stability, electronic structure, and optoelectronic behaviour of the TDMIM·BF4-ZnO hybrid conformations. The influence of ZnO incorporation on the structural, electronic, spectroscopic, and optoelectronic properties of the ILC-ZnO hybrid conformations was investigated. Particular attention was given to changes in the electronic distribution and charge-transfer characteristics using frontier molecular orbital (FMO) analysis and energy-gap calculations, while molecular electrostatic potential (MESP) and work-function analyses were employed to examine the modified surface electronic environment and charge-transport characteristics. The photovoltaic relevance of the hybrid systems was further examined through light-harvesting efficiency (LHE), open-circuit voltage (Vₒc), and fill factor (FF) under AM 1.5G solar irradiation. The study provides insight into the role of ZnO incorporation in enhancing the optical and electronic characteristics of TDMIM·BF₄ and its potential applicability in the design of hybrid DSSC materials.Methods- Density functional theory (DFT) calculations were performed using Gaussian 09 to optimize C14MIM.BF4, ZnO clusters, and C14MIM.BF4-(ZnO)ₙ (n = 2–8) hybrid conformations. Geometry optimizations were carried out using the B3LYP functional with the 6-311 + + G(d,p) basis set for H, C, N, O, and F atoms, while the LANL2DZ effective core potential was employed for Zn.

full_list.title_en: Arbitrary-order exceptional points in a nanomechanical cavity
full_list.title_zh: 纳米力学腔中的任意阶异常点
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.11679v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Exceptional points (EPs), non-Hermitian spectral singularities, shape the evolution dynamics ranging from topological mode control to high-precision sensing. Higher-order EPs unlock enriched and sharpened spectral topology beyond the minimal second-order counterpart, thus expanding capabilities in those domains. However, the intrinsic topological fragility of higher-order EPs has long hindered their robust experimental realization. Here, we present a scalable architecture that implements arbitrary-order EPs via an optically mediated recurrent network comprising a single nanomechanical resonator and an ensemble of digital synthetic resonators. We experimentally validate this architecture's scalability for both linear and nonlinear mechanical EPs, demonstrating EPs up to the seventh order. Moreover, we reveal that the fundamental noise component, in contrast to some technical-noise contributions, shares the same system coupling channel and undergoes identical root-response amplification as the measured signal. The co-amplification mechanism sets the fundamental sensitivity limit near EPs of any order, as verified by direct signal-to-noise ratio measurements. Our work establishes a general platform for exploring higher-order EP-based phenomena while clarifying the fundamental boundary of non-Hermitian sensitivity enhancement. More broadly, it facilitates a connection between non-Hermitian physics and AI-inspired recurrent architectures across diverse physical systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 异常点 (EP)、非厄米光谱奇点塑造了从拓扑模式控制到高精度传感的演化动态。高阶 EP 解锁了超出最小二阶对应物的丰富且锐化的光谱拓扑，从而扩展了这些领域的功能。然而，高阶电势内在的拓扑脆弱性长期以来阻碍了其稳健的实验实现。在这里，我们提出了一种可扩展的架构，通过光介导的循环网络实现任意阶 EP，该网络包括单个纳米机械谐振器和数字合成谐振器的集合。我们通过实验验证了该架构对于线性和非线性机械 EP 的可扩展性，展示了高达七阶的 EP。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 异常点 (EP)、非厄米光谱奇点塑造了从拓扑模式控制到高精度传感的演化动态。高阶 EP 解锁了超出最小二阶对应物的丰富且锐化的光谱拓扑，从而扩展了这些领域的功能。然而，高阶电势内在的拓扑脆弱性长期以来阻碍了其稳健的实验实现。在这里，我们提出了一种可扩展的架构，通过光介导的循环网络实现任意阶 EP，该网络包括单个纳米机械谐振器和数字合成谐振器的集合。我们通过实验验证了该架构对于线性和非线性机械 EP 的可扩展性，展示了高达七阶的 EP。此外，我们发现，与一些技术噪声贡献相比，基本噪声分量共享相同的系统耦合通道，并经历与测量信号相同的根响应放大。共放大机制设置了任意阶 EP 附近的基本灵敏度极限，这一点通过直接信噪比测量进行了验证。我们的工作建立了一个通用平台，用于探索基于 EP 的高阶现象，同时阐明非厄米灵敏度增强的基本边界。更广泛地说，它促进了非厄米物理学和跨不同物理系统的人工智能启发的循环架构之间的联系。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《纳米力学腔中的任意阶异常点》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Compass Correlations in a Square-Lattice Magnet
full_list.title_zh: 方格磁铁中的罗盘相关性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32157v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The square-lattice compass model is a paradigm of bond-dependent frustration, yet experimental evidence for its characteristic spin correlations has remained elusive. Here we identify compass correlations in the square-lattice intermetallic ErRu₂Si₂ using single-crystal neutron diffuse scattering. Comparative measurements on the isostructural compounds NdRu₂Si₂ and ErRu₂Si₂ reveal a pronounced contrast between nearly uniform diffuse rings in the former and strong intensity modulation between Brillouin zones in the latter. Through the magnetic neutron polarization factor, this modulation reveals compass correlations that couple moment orientation to the correlation wavevector. Crystal-field spectroscopy identifies four preferred in-plane orientations for the Er³⁺ moments. A minimal compass-Heisenberg model incorporating this anisotropy quantitatively reproduces the diffuse scattering and accounts for the double-Q vortex-antivortex ground state. Fits with the compass couplings fixed at values set by the dipolar energy scale retain good agreement with the data, supporting a substantial dipolar contribution to the bond-dependent interactions. Our results establish a square-lattice platform for compass physics and suggest that dipolar interactions, acting together with local crystal-field anisotropy, can shape directional magnetic correlations alongside conduction-electron-mediated exchange.
full_list.abstract_zh: 方格罗盘模型是键相关挫败的范例，但其特征自旋相关性的实验证据仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们使用单晶中子漫散射识别方晶格金属间化合物 ErRu2Si2 中的罗盘相关性。对同构化合物 NdRu2Si2 和 ErRu2Si2 的比较测量表明，前者几乎均匀的扩散环与后者布里渊区之间的强强度调制之间存在显着对比。通过磁中子极化因子，这种调制揭示了将力矩方向耦合到相关波矢量的罗盘相关性。晶体场光谱确定了 Er³⁺ 矩的四种优选面内取向。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 方格罗盘模型是键相关挫败的范例，但其特征自旋相关性的实验证据仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们使用单晶中子漫散射识别方晶格金属间化合物 ErRu2Si2 中的罗盘相关性。对同构化合物 NdRu2Si2 和 ErRu2Si2 的比较测量表明，前者几乎均匀的扩散环与后者布里渊区之间的强强度调制之间存在显着对比。通过磁中子极化因子，这种调制揭示了将力矩方向耦合到相关波矢量的罗盘相关性。晶体场光谱确定了 Er³⁺ 矩的四种优选面内取向。结合了这种各向异性的最小罗盘-海森堡模型定量地再现了漫散射并解释了双 Q 涡旋-反涡旋基态。与固定在偶极能量尺度设定的值的罗盘耦合的拟合与数据保持良好的一致性，支持对键依赖性相互作用的重大偶极贡献。我们的结果为罗盘物理建立了一个方晶格平台，并表明偶极相互作用与局部晶体场各向异性一起作用，可以在传导电子介导的交换旁边形成定向磁相关性。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《方格磁铁中的罗盘相关性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Dipole chains of Bloch point singularities revealed by X-ray magnetic tomography
full_list.title_zh: X 射线磁断层扫描揭示布洛赫点奇点的偶极子链
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.31952v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bloch point singularities play an important role in magnetic systems, mediating changes in topology in three dimensional configurations. However, until now they have only been observed as isolated objects or as part of individual topological textures. Here we present the experimental observation of a 1D dipole chain of Bloch points in an anisotropic chiral magnet using soft X-ray magnetic vector tomography. We identify that the chain of Bloch point singularities lies along a boundary between regions of opposite chirality and that neighbouring Bloch and anti-Bloch points are stable at separations down to 60 nm. The stability of the Bloch points is determined to be closely related to the surrounding topology of the magnetisation configuration and a threshold separation for the spontaneous annihilation of Bloch point-anti-Bloch point pairs within chiral domain walls is identified to be approximately 90 nm in distance. This observation of a chain of Bloch points and the insight into their stability, offers a route to explore the correlative behaviour of such topological point defects. The behaviour and control of such point defects is of relevance for the control of 3D magnetisation configurations, and provides a new route towards the creation of correlated configurations of singularities in a magnetic system.
full_list.abstract_zh: 布洛赫点奇点在磁系统中发挥着重要作用，调节三维结构中的拓扑变化。然而，到目前为止，它们仅被视为孤立的物体或个体拓扑纹理的一部分。在这里，我们展示了使用软 X 射线磁矢量断层扫描对各向异性手性磁体中布洛赫点的一维偶极链进行的实验观察。我们发现布洛赫点奇点链位于相反手性区域之间的边界，并且相邻的布洛赫点和反布洛赫点在间距小至 60 nm 时保持稳定。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 布洛赫点奇点在磁系统中发挥着重要作用，调节三维结构中的拓扑变化。然而，到目前为止，它们仅被视为孤立的物体或个体拓扑纹理的一部分。在这里，我们展示了使用软 X 射线磁矢量断层扫描对各向异性手性磁体中布洛赫点的一维偶极链进行的实验观察。我们发现布洛赫点奇点链位于相反手性区域之间的边界，并且相邻的布洛赫点和反布洛赫点在间距小至 60 nm 时保持稳定。布洛赫点的稳定性被确定为与磁化构型的周围拓扑密切相关，并且手性畴壁内的布洛赫点-反布洛赫点对自发湮灭的阈值间隔被确定为距离大约90 nm。对布洛赫点链的观察以及对其稳定性的深入了解，为探索此类拓扑点缺陷的相关行为提供了一条途径。此类点缺陷的行为和控制与 3D 磁化配置的控制相关，并为在磁系统中创建奇点的相关配置提供了一条新途径。

full_list.title_en: Divalent Yb in the Ca₃Pd₄Bi₈ Structure Type: Crystal Growth and Physical Properties of Yb₃Pd₄Bi₈
full_list.title_zh: Ca₃Pd₄Bi₈结构类型中的二价Yb：Yb₃Pd₄Bi₈的晶体生长和物理性质
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32524v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report on the single-crystal growth, crystal structure, and physical properties of Yb₃Pd₄Bi₈. Single crystal x-ray diffraction shows that the material crystallizes in the Ca₃Pd₄Bi₈ structure-type at ambient conditions, described by orthorhombic symmetry Pbam. Magnetization measurements reveal a nearly isotropic diamagnetic response, indicating that Yb is stabilized in a non-magnetic divalent configuration. Electrical resistivity measurements show a metallic behavior. First-principles calculations including spin--orbit coupling describe a metal whose states at the Fermi level are dominated by Bi 6p orbitals, with a density of states within 1% of that of the isoelectronic compound Ca₃Pd₄Bi₈, consistent with a filled and chemically inert 4f shell. They further show that the nonsymmorphic symmetry of the crystal enforces fourfold-degenerate nodal lines on the Brillouin-zone boundary, four of which cross the Fermi level and give symmetry-enforced Dirac points with a linear transverse dispersion. Despite strong metallic and covalent bonding within the Pd-Bi network, Yb₃Pd₄Bi₈ is realized as a rare-earth analog of the Ca₃Pd₄Bi₈ structure type with divalent Yb ions. This result offers a potential avenue to discover other rare-earth analogs within this structural family.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们报告了 Yb₃Pd₄Bi₈ 的单晶生长、晶体结构和物理性质。单晶X射线衍射表明，该材料在环境条件下以Ca 3 Pd 4 Bi 8 结构类型结晶，用斜方对称性Pbam描述。磁化测量揭示了近乎各向同性的抗磁响应，表明 Yb 稳定在非磁性二价构型中。电阻率测量显示出金属行为。包括自旋轨道耦合在内的第一性原理计算描述了一种金属，其费米能级状态由 Bi 6p 轨道主导，其态密度与等电子化合物 Ca₃Pd₄Bi₈ 的态密度在 1% 以内，与填充且化学惰性的 4f 壳层一致。

full_list.title_en: Effect of oxygen plasma treatment on the structural and superconducting properties of atomic-layer-deposited NbN thin films
full_list.title_zh: 氧等离子体处理对原子层沉积NbN薄膜结构和超导性能的影响
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Surface oxidation is a common concern for ultrathin NbN superconducting devices, yet which superconducting properties it affects has not been established for films grown by plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition. We expose NbN films about 11.4 nm thick to an O₂ plasma for 0 to 60 s, which oxidizes the surface without etching the film, and characterize the same sample series by X-ray diffraction, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and transport measurements on 500 nm wide nanowires. XPS of the surface and the underlying layer shows that the plasma converts the surface to Nb₂O₅, whereas the bulk of the treated film is chemically identical to that of the untreated film. Crystalline δ-NbN remains intact. During exposure, the total film thickness rises and saturates between 40 and 60 s, indicating self-limiting surface oxide growth. The normal-state resistivity rises by 21% (dc) and 25% (optical) with the plasma dose, while the critical temperature and transition width are unchanged. The switching current densities of 4.9-6.2 MA/cm² at 4.2 K show no systematic dependence on the plasma dose. Their temperature dependence follows the dirty-limit depairing current of Kupriyanov and Lukichev, and the extrapolated switching currents reach 39-46% of the depairing current calculated from the optical resistivity and diffusion coefficient, in agreement with the width dependence reported for nanowires from the same process. The oxygen signature is confined to temperatures near T_c, where the supercurrent of the treated wires vanishes at least 0.5 K earlier than that of the untreated wire, consistent with a partially oxidized surface layer that acts on the film by the proximity effect. At these doses, oxygen narrows the temperature range of the supercurrent from above but does not systematically reduce the low-temperature current-carrying capacity of the wires.
full_list.abstract_zh: 表面氧化是超薄 NbN 超导器件的一个常见问题，但对于等离子体增强原子层沉积生长的薄膜，其超导特性的影响尚未确定。我们将约 11.4 nm 厚的 NbN 薄膜暴露在 O2 等离子体中 0 至 60 秒，氧化表面而不蚀刻薄膜，并通过 X 射线衍射、X 射线光电子能谱 (XPS) 和 500 nm 宽纳米线上的传输测量来表征相同的样品系列。表面和底层的 XPS 显示等离子体将表面转化为 Nb2O5，而处理过的薄膜的大部分在化学上与未处理的薄膜相同。晶体 δ-NbN 保持完整。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 表面氧化是超薄 NbN 超导器件的一个常见问题，但对于等离子体增强原子层沉积生长的薄膜，其超导特性的影响尚未确定。我们将约 11.4 nm 厚的 NbN 薄膜暴露在 O2 等离子体中 0 至 60 秒，氧化表面而不蚀刻薄膜，并通过 X 射线衍射、X 射线光电子能谱 (XPS) 和 500 nm 宽纳米线上的传输测量来表征相同的样品系列。表面和底层的 XPS 显示等离子体将表面转化为 Nb2O5，而处理过的薄膜的大部分在化学上与未处理的薄膜相同。晶体 δ-NbN 保持完整。在曝光期间，总膜厚度在 40 至 60 秒之间上升并饱和，表明表面氧化物生长自限性。随着等离子体剂量的增加，常态电阻率增加了 21%（直流）和 25%（光学），而临界温度和转变宽度保持不变。 4.2 K 时的开关电流密度为 4.9-6.2 MA/cm²，显示出对等离子体剂量没有系统依赖性。它们的温度依赖性遵循 Kupriyanov 和 Lukichev 的肮脏极限脱对电流，并且外推的开关电流达到根据光学电阻率和扩散系数计算的脱对电流的 39-46%，与来自同一工艺的纳米线报告的宽度依赖性一致。氧特征仅限于 T_c 附近的温度，其中处理过的导线的超电流比未处理的导线早至少 0.5 K 消失，这与通过邻近效应作用于薄膜的部分氧化表面层一致。在这些剂量下，氧气从上方缩小了超电流的温度范围，但不会系统地降低电线的低温载流能力。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《氧等离子体处理对原子层沉积NbN薄膜结构和超导性能的影响》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Electron Wavefronts Capture Nanoscale Movies of Hypersound at Surfaces
full_list.title_zh: 电子波前捕捉表面超音波的纳米级电影
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Acoustic waves transport mechanical energy and elastic strain through solids, with material composition and shape governing their propagation. In the gigahertz hypersound regime, acoustic wavelengths reach tens to hundreds of nanometres, comparable to nanoscale device dimensions. Harnessing these waves underpins high-frequency signal processing, sensing, electromagnetic coupling and quantum control. Acoustic metrology probes elastic modes and internal interfaces. Yet directly imaging how nanoscale acoustic waves interact with local structure remains challenging, requiring picometre displacement sensitivity combined with high spatiotemporal resolution. Here we demonstrate full-field imaging of laser-induced hypersound at surfaces using reflected electron wavefronts. We introduce ultrafast low-energy electron microscopy (ULEEM), exploiting the intrinsic surface sensitivity of few-electronvolt electrons. Coherent electron pulses down to femtosecond durations reflect from the topmost atomic layers, imprinting the evolving surface profile onto their wavefronts. Defocus converts phase variations into image contrast. In a thin van der Waals material, we image the thermoelastic generation and propagation of picometre-amplitude acoustic waves. Measured dispersion relations, interpreted through elastodynamic modelling, distinguish substrate-supported and locally detached regions, revealing how interfacial contact shapes propagation. Delayed wave emission reveals scattering at buried mechanical defects. Our results establish electron-wavefront imaging of nanoscale surface dynamics, enabling the exploration of ultrafast energy transport, structural transformations and coupled mechanical, electronic and magnetic phenomena.
full_list.abstract_zh: 声波通过固体传输机械能和弹性应变，材料成分和形状控制其传播。在千兆赫超音速范围内，声波波长达到数十至数百纳米，与纳米级设备尺寸相当。利用这些波支撑高频信号处理、传感、电磁耦合和量子控制。声学计量探测弹性模式和内部界面。然而，直接成像纳米级声波如何与局部结构相互作用仍然具有挑战性，需要皮米位移灵敏度与高时空分辨率相结合。在这里，我们展示了使用反射电子波前对表面激光诱导超音速进行全场成像。我们引入了超快低能电子显微镜（ULEEM），利用了少电子伏电子的固有表面敏感性。

full_list.title_en: Field Directed Assembly of Anisotropic Composite Pacman Colloids into Reconfigurable Architectures
full_list.title_zh: 将各向异性复合 Pacman 胶体现场定向组装成可重构架构
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32872v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the field-directed assembly of patchy colloidal particles composed of magnetic hematite cubes encapsulated in TPM shells. These Pacman-like particles exhibit specific interactions via their magnetic patch, enabling tunable structures under external fields. A magnetic field drives patch-to-patch interactions, while an AC electric field induces stacking and spreading. By using this multi-field combination and by varying field parameters, such as frequency and amplitude, we achieve programmable transitions between distinct assembly modes. Our work offers a versatile platform for designing reconfigurable colloidal architectures with potential applications in micro-robotics and smart materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由封装在 TPM 壳中的磁性赤铁矿立方体组成的片状胶体颗粒的场定向组装。这些类似吃豆人的粒子通过其磁性贴片表现出特定的相互作用，从而在外部场下实现可调谐结构。磁场驱动贴片与贴片之间的相互作用，而交流电场则引起堆叠和扩散。通过使用这种多场组合并通过改变频率和幅度等场参数，我们实现了不同组装模式之间的可编程转换。我们的工作为设计可重构胶体结构提供了一个多功能平台，在微型机器人和智能材料方面具有潜在的应用。

full_list.title_en: Finite-Temperature Transconductance of Multiterminal Josephson Junctions with Topological Andreev Spectra
full_list.title_zh: 多端约瑟夫森结的有限温度跨导与拓扑安德烈夫谱
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32839v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiterminal Josephson junctions (MTJJs) provide a controllable platform for engineering topological Andreev spectra. At zero temperature, Andreev bound states (ABSs) with nonzero Chern numbers give rise to quantized transconductance between superconducting terminals. We derive the finite-temperature transconductance of MTJJs using linear-response theory. We first demonstrate the destructive role of temperature: changes in the thermal occupations of the ABSs destroy exact transconductance quantization. We then show that finite temperature can also play a constructive role by making the transconductance sensitive to finite-energy topological crossings hidden from the zero-temperature response. Our results establish the thermal limitations of transconductance quantization and identify finite-temperature transport as a probe of otherwise inaccessible topology in Andreev spectra.
full_list.abstract_zh: 多端约瑟夫森结（MTJJ）为工程拓扑安德烈夫谱提供了一个可控平台。在零温度下，具有非零陈数的安德烈夫束缚态（ABS）会在超导端子之间产生量化跨导。我们使用线性响应理论推导了 MTJJ 的有限温度跨导。我们首先证明了温度的破坏性作用：ABS 热占据的变化破坏了精确的跨导量化。然后，我们表明，通过使跨导对隐藏在零温度响应中的有限能量拓扑交叉敏感，有限温度也可以发挥建设性作用。我们的结果确立了跨导量化的热限制，并将有限温度输运确定为安德烈夫谱中其他无法访问的拓扑结构的探针。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《多端约瑟夫森结的有限温度跨导与拓扑安德烈夫谱》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Generating entanglement in quantum matter with pathway-entangled photons via resonant inelastic X-ray scattering
full_list.title_zh: 通过共振非弹性 X 射线散射在量子物质中产生路径纠缠光子的纠缠
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32936v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) is conventionally used to probe elementary excitations and correlations in quantum materials. Here, we propose an interferometric RIXS protocol that instead creates entanglement between spatially separated regions of a solid-state material. An incident X-ray photon is coherently split by a beam splitter into two arms illuminating opposite ends of a sample. Recombining the scattered photons at a second beam splitter and detecting an energy-selected photon then projects the material into a coherent superposition of excitations at the two ends. This protocol is the X-ray, solid-state analogue of the Duan-Lukin-Cirac-Zoller (DLCZ) heralding scheme. Using a Kramers-Heisenberg formalism with quantized photon modes, we show that orthogonal and degenerate end excitations yield maximally entangled states. We illustrate this mechanism in three models: (1) two decoupled sites yield a heralded Bell state. (2) An open tight-binding chain exhibits reflection-parity-dependent interference, providing a benchmark for the interferometer's coherence. (3) A spin-1 Haldane (AKLT) chain yields an entangled pair of fractionalized edge spins. We also discuss practical considerations and challenges for realizing the protocol in X-ray experiments.
full_list.abstract_zh: 共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 通常用于探测量子材料中的基本激发和相关性。在这里，我们提出了一种干涉 RIXS 协议，该协议在固态材料的空间分离区域之间产生纠缠。入射 X 射线光子被分束器相干地分成两个臂，照亮样品的相对端。在第二个分束器处重新组合散射光子并检测能量选择的光子，然后将材料投射到两端激发的相干叠加中。该协议是 Duan-Lukin-Cirac-Zoller (DLCZ) 预示方案的 X 射线固态模拟。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 通常用于探测量子材料中的基本激发和相关性。在这里，我们提出了一种干涉 RIXS 协议，该协议在固态材料的空间分离区域之间产生纠缠。入射 X 射线光子被分束器相干地分成两个臂，照亮样品的相对端。在第二个分束器处重新组合散射光子并检测能量选择的光子，然后将材料投射到两端激发的相干叠加中。该协议是 Duan-Lukin-Cirac-Zoller (DLCZ) 预示方案的 X 射线固态模拟。使用具有量化光子模式的克拉默斯-海森堡形式主义，我们表明正交和简并的末端激发产生最大纠缠态。我们用三个模型来说明这种机制：（1）两个解耦位点产生预示着的贝尔态。 (2)开放的紧束缚链表现出反射奇偶校验相关的干涉，为干涉仪的相干性提供了基准。 (3) 自旋 1 Haldane (AKLT) 链产生一对纠缠的碎片化边缘自旋。我们还讨论了在 X 射线实验中实现协议的实际考虑因素和挑战。

full_list.title_en: Ginzburg-Landau Theory with Elastic Incompatibility Describes the Liquid-G-phase-Crystal State Diagram
full_list.title_zh: 具有弹性不相容性的金兹堡-朗道理论描述了液相-G-相-晶体状态图
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32791v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive a mechanically consistent Ginzburg-Landau theory for the metastable heterogeneous G state reported in deeply undercooled metallic liquids. The central result is that type-II-like mixed-state physics can emerge structurally with the random internal stress field playing the role of the magnetic field. Frozen eigenstrain due to elastic incompatibility between ordered cores and the amorphous matrix generates incompatible stress, while the non-affine internal strain in the liquid-like matrix in between the ordered cores relaxes that stress over a finite screening length λ_σ (analogous to the London length in the superconducting problem). Structural order heals over a distinct mechanically-dressed length ξ_G; their ratio κ_G=λ_σ/ξ_G provides the structural counterpart of the Ginzburg-Landau parameter. Because the matrix is transiently rigid yet locally relaxational only over an intermediate time window, the same mechanism selects crystal for slow protocols, a heterogeneous G state at intermediate rates, and a homogeneous L-like glass under rapid arrest. Residual incompatibility frustrates coarsening, allowing finite ordered cores and screened, orientation-dependent core interactions. The resulting texture is an inverted Abrikosov analogue: structural order resides in the cores, whereas incompatible-stress screening is carried by the surrounding disordered matrix. The theory yields direct simulation and experimental tests through stress-decay, structural-healing, non-affine-susceptibility, and kinetic measurements.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们针对深度过冷金属液体中报道的亚稳态异质 G 态导出了机械上一致的 Ginzburg-Landau 理论。核心结果是，随着随机内应力场在磁场的作用下，类II型混合态物理可以在结构上出现。由于有序核和非晶基体之间的弹性不相容性而冻结的特征应变会产生不相容的应力，而有序核之间的类液基体中的非仿射内应变会在有限的屏蔽长度 λ_σ（类似于超导问题中的伦敦长度）上松弛该应力。结构秩序在一个独特的机械装饰长度 Υ_G 上愈合；
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们针对深度过冷金属液体中报道的亚稳态异质 G 态导出了机械上一致的 Ginzburg-Landau 理论。核心结果是，随着随机内应力场在磁场的作用下，类II型混合态物理可以在结构上出现。由于有序核和非晶基体之间的弹性不相容性而冻结的特征应变会产生不相容的应力，而有序核之间的类液基体中的非仿射内应变会在有限的屏蔽长度 λ_σ（类似于超导问题中的伦敦长度）上松弛该应力。结构秩序在一个独特的机械装饰长度 Υ_G 上愈合；它们的比率 κ_G=λ_σ/ϋ_G 提供了 Ginzburg-Landau 参数的结构对应物。由于基质是瞬态刚性的，但仅在中间时间窗口内局部松弛，因此相同的机制选择用于慢速协议的晶体、中等速率下的异质 G 态以及快速停止下的均匀 L 状玻璃。残余的不相容性会阻碍粗化，从而允许有限有序的核心和筛选的、依赖于方向的核心相互作用。由此产生的纹理是一个倒置的阿布里科索夫类似物：结构顺序位于核心中，而不相容应力筛选则由周围的无序矩阵进行。该理论通过应力衰减、结构修复、非仿射敏感性和动力学测量产生直接模拟和实验测试。

full_list.title_en: High-quality, deep formation and identification of oxygen-vacancy defects in silicon carbide
full_list.title_zh: 碳化硅中氧空位缺陷的高质量、深层形成和识别
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optically addressable paramagnetic defects in silicon carbide (SiC) are attractive for scalable quantum technologies such as quantum sensing. PL5, PL6, and PL7 are promising defects for their high brightness and spin-readout contrast. Although generation by oxygen implantation has been reported very recently, nonuniform spin and optical properties and the limited generation depth of implanted defects hinder both high-sensitivity sensing and conclusive microscopic identification. Here we engineer high-quality defects by decoupling oxygen incorporation and defect formation, realizing highly homogeneous spin-resonance frequencies as well as narrow optical linewidths and long T2* coherence time. Further, we demonstrate defect formation beyond the ion range utilizing oxygen diffusion, exceptional among impurities in SiC. We further provide hyperfine-interaction statistics of 17O and host nuclei across many PL6 defects, making the oxygen-vacancy origin conclusive. Together, the microscopic identification and the demonstrated formation route establish a foundation for developing the oxygen-vacancy spin defect into a versatile quantum platform.
full_list.abstract_zh: 碳化硅 (SiC) 中的光学可寻址顺磁缺陷对于量子传感等可扩展量子技术很有吸引力。 PL5、PL6 和 PL7 因其高亮度和自旋读出对比度而成为有希望的缺陷。尽管最近报道了通过氧注入产生的缺陷，但不均匀的自旋和光学特性以及注入缺陷的有限生成深度阻碍了高灵敏度传感和最终的微观识别。在这里，我们通过解耦氧掺入和缺陷形成来设计高质量缺陷，实现高度均匀的自旋共振频率以及窄光学线宽和长 T2* 相干时间。此外，我们证明了利用氧扩散在离子范围之外形成缺陷，这在 SiC 的杂质中是特殊的。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 带电缺陷、缺陷形成能、陷阱态和器件退化在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《碳化硅中氧空位缺陷的高质量、深层形成和识别》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Hybrid Monte Carlo for the extended Kane-Mele-Hubbard model
full_list.title_zh: 扩展 Kane-Mele-Hubbard 模型的混合蒙特卡罗
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32458v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Hubbard model offers a powerful minimal description of strongly correlated electrons in molecules and materials, yet it neglects effects observed in nature that give rise to a much richer variety of physics. For instance, including nonlocal interactions introduces a competition between strongly correlated phases, while incorporating spin-orbit coupling (SOC) can lead to the emergence of exotic topological phases. Seeking a more realistic platform for simulating graphene and, potentially, related materials such as transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), we therefore consider the extended Kane-Mele-Hubbard model, which features a Kane-Mele SOC term and nearest-neighbor interactions. Simulating this model is particularly challenging once the nonlocal interactions become dominant over the on-site Hubbard interaction, as a severe sign problem arises already at half filling, leaving this regime largely unexplored. In this work, we develop continuous auxiliary field formulations of the model, suitable for treatment with the Hybrid Monte Carlo (HMC) algorithm. Using these formulations, we characterize the sign problem across the model's parameter space and establish where simulations are feasible, as a first step toward the full phase diagram.
full_list.abstract_zh: 哈伯德模型对分子和材料中的强相关电子提供了强有力的最小描述，但它忽略了在自然界中观察到的影响，而这些影响产生了更丰富的物理现象。例如，包括非局域相互作用会引入强相关相之间的竞争，而合并自旋轨道耦合（SOC）可能会导致奇异拓扑相的出现。为了寻求一个更现实的平台来模拟石墨烯以及可能的相关材料，例如过渡金属二硫化物 (TMD)，因此我们考虑扩展的 Kane-Mele-Hubbard 模型，该模型具有 Kane-Mele SOC 项和最近邻相互作用。

full_list.title_en: Ideal interaction dynamics of defects and background fields in condensed matter
full_list.title_zh: 凝聚态物质中缺陷和背景场的理想相互作用动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32973v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While defect dynamics in condensed matter systems is widely studied and several methods are available to track the defect position over time, the formulation of dynamical models for the coupled evolution of both defect and background field quantities seems to be more challenging. Yet, the overall behavior of a system containing moving defects is strongly influenced by this defect-field interaction. Here, we propose a modeling framework for the conservative coupled evolution of the defect density and the background fields upon focusing on two relevant cases of study: the Gross-Pitaevskii theory of quantum fluids and the Ericksen-Leslie model of nematic liquid crystals. To achieve the coupled evolution, we combine the Euler-Poincaré variational setting of continuum dynamics with the gauge theory of topological defects. While the latter allows us to overcome certain ambiguities in definition of the defect density, the Euler-Poincaré method provides a unified modeling approach in the absence of defect reconnection.
full_list.abstract_zh: 虽然凝聚态系统中的缺陷动力学得到了广泛的研究，并且有几种方法可以跟踪缺陷位置随时间的变化，但缺陷和背景场量耦合演化的动力学模型的制定似乎更具挑战性。然而，包含移动缺陷的系统的整体行为受到这种缺陷场相互作用的强烈影响。在这里，我们提出了一个缺陷密度和背景场保守耦合演化的建模框架，重点关注两个相关的研究案例：量子流体的 Gross-Pitaevskii 理论和向列液晶的 Ericksen-Leslie 模型。

full_list.title_en: Interface Control of Second-Harmonic Generation in Layered CuInP2S6 via PbZr0.2Ti0.8O3 Domain Wall
full_list.title_zh: PbZr0.2Ti0.8O3畴壁对层状CuInP2S6二次谐波产生的界面控制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32228v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The control of nonlinear optical responses in van der Waals ferroelectrics at the nanoscale offers opportunities for developing two-dimensional integrated nanophotonics with programmable functionalities. In this work, we report the first realization of nanoscale nonvolatile control of the amplitude and polarization of second-harmonic generation (SHG) response in layered CuInP2S6 (CIPS) via the domain structure in an interfacial PbZr0.2Ti0.8O3 (PZT) thin film. The SHG intensity at CIPS/PZT heterointerface is continuously modulated, either substantially enhanced or almost entirely quenched, by the circular domain walls in underlying ferroelectric oxide. The interfacial coupling of CIPS polar axis with in-plane polarization of PZT domain walls tailors the SHG light polarization into two-fold (C2V) symmetry, which is well modeled by nonlinear electromagnetic theory. Overall, this study enables nonvolatile programmable design of nonlinear light intensity and polarization in van der Waals ferroelectrics at the nanoscale.
full_list.abstract_zh: 纳米尺度范德华铁电体非线性光学响应的控制为开发具有可编程功能的二维集成纳米光子学提供了机会。在这项工作中，我们报告了通过界面 PbZr0.2Ti0.8O3 (PZT) 薄膜中的域结构首次实现了对层状 CuInP2S6 (CIPS) 中二次谐波产生 (SHG) 响应的振幅和偏振的纳米级非易失性控制。 CIPS/PZT 异质界面处的 SHG 强度通过下面的铁电氧化物中的圆形畴壁连续调制，要么显着增强，要么几乎完全淬灭。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Intrinsic defects and 4d/5d transition metal defects in Cr₂O₃: pathways for enhancing the Néel temperature
full_list.title_zh: Cr2O3 中的本征缺陷和 4d/5d 过渡金属缺陷：提高尼尔温度的途径
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2506.10883v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: First-principles calculations are employed to explore avenues to increase the Néel temperature (TN) of the magnetoelectric antiferromagnet Cr₂O₃ through doping. Employing the hybrid functional method, we calculate the formation energy of intrinsic defects and transition metal dopants (Mo, W, Nb, Ta, Zr, and Hf) to assess their likelihood of formation. Intrinsic defect calculations indicate that Cr interstitials and oxygen vacancies dominate under Cr-rich conditions, whereas Cr vacancies prevail under O-rich conditions. Notably, under Cr-rich conditions, the Fermi level can be pinned slightly above mid-gap due to the formation of Cr interstitials and oxygen vacancies. Additionally, we identify a split Cr vacancy configuration that is more energetically stable than a normal Cr vacancy in corundum Cr₂O₃. To assess the influence of dopants on TN of Cr₂O₃, we calculate the enhancement of the exchange energy for the spin at the dopant site or at an adjacent Cr site using the supercell method.Our study identifies isovalent Mo and W substitutions at Cr sites as the most promising candidates for increasing the Néel temperature because of impurity-mediated enhancement of the exchange interaction for half-filled bands. Formation-energy calculations indicate that Mo and W substitutions at Cr sites form more readily under Cr-rich conditions and that a Fermi level near or slightly above midgap stabilizes the desirable neutral charge states of the Mo and W defects. This is assisted by the formation of intrinsic Cr interstitials and O vacancies under Cr-rich conditions. These findings offer a route to utilize defects for higher TNand enhanced performance of Cr₂O₃ in magnetoelectric devices and provide useful guidance for future experimental studies.
full_list.abstract_zh: 采用第一性原理计算来探索通过掺杂提高磁电反铁磁体 Cr2O3 的尼尔温度 (TN) 的途径。采用混合泛函方法，我们计算了本征缺陷和过渡金属掺杂剂（Mo、W、Nb、Ta、Zr 和 Hf）的形成能，以评估它们形成的可能性。固有缺陷计算表明，在富Cr条件下，Cr间隙和氧空位占主导地位，而在富O条件下，Cr空位占主导地位。值得注意的是，在富铬条件下，由于铬间隙和氧空位的形成，费米能级可以固定在略高于中间能隙的位置。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 采用第一性原理计算来探索通过掺杂提高磁电反铁磁体 Cr2O3 的尼尔温度 (TN) 的途径。采用混合泛函方法，我们计算了本征缺陷和过渡金属掺杂剂（Mo、W、Nb、Ta、Zr 和 Hf）的形成能，以评估它们形成的可能性。固有缺陷计算表明，在富Cr条件下，Cr间隙和氧空位占主导地位，而在富O条件下，Cr空位占主导地位。值得注意的是，在富铬条件下，由于铬间隙和氧空位的形成，费米能级可以固定在略高于中间能隙的位置。此外，我们还发现了一种分裂的 Cr 空位构型，它比刚玉 Cr2O₃ 中的正常 Cr 空位更加稳定。为了评估掺杂剂对 Cr2O₃ TN 的影响，我们使用超晶胞方法计算了掺杂剂位点或相邻 Cr 位点处自旋交换能的增强。我们的研究确定 Cr 位点的等价 Mo 和 W 取代是提高尼尔温度的最有希望的候选者，因为半填充能带的交换相互作用通过杂质介导增强。形成能计算表明，在富铬条件下，Cr位点处的Mo和W取代更容易形成，并且接近或略高于中带隙的费米能级稳定了Mo和W缺陷的理想中性电荷态。在富铬条件下，本征 Cr 间隙原子和 O 空位的形成有助于实现这一点。这些发现为利用缺陷来提高磁电器件中的 TN 和增强 Cr2O3 的性能提供了一条途径，并为未来的实验研究提供了有用的指导。

full_list.title_en: Kagome goldene with flat bands and Dirac nodal line fermions via line-graph epitaxy
full_list.title_zh: 通过线图外延获得平带和狄拉克节点线费米子的 Kagome Goldene
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2503.07945v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The kagome lattice has emerged as a promising platform for investigating exotic quantum phases. However, achieving a single-atomic-layer kagome lattice in elemental materials remains a significant challenge. Here, we introduce line-graph epitaxy, a novel approach that enables the atomic-scale synthesis of goldene, a monolayer of elemental gold atoms arranged in a kagome lattice. Through scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy (STM/STS), and density functional theory (DFT) calculations, we demonstrate the formation of kagome goldene, featuring a flat band with a van Hove singularity approximately 1.1 eV below the Fermi level, signaling strong electron correlation effects. Notably, the flat band is disrupted at the zigzag edges of goldene nanoflakes, revealing substantial edge effects. Furthermore, our calculations show that weak interlayer interactions between goldene and the underlying Au2Ge substrate generate dual Dirac nodal lines through a proximity effect. These findings offer not only a novel strategy for constructing elemental kagome lattices, but also a generalizable framework for fabricating and controlling line-graph materials. This research advances the exploration of quantum phases driven by strong correlations and the design of materials for next-generation quantum technologies.
full_list.abstract_zh: kagome 晶格已成为研究奇异量子相的有前途的平台。然而，在元素材料中实现单原子层戈薇晶格仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们介绍了线图外延，这是一种能够原子级合成goldene的新方法，goldene是排列在kagome晶格中的单层元素金原子。通过扫描隧道显微镜/光谱学 (STM/STS) 和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算，我们证明了 Kagome Goldene 的形成，其特征是具有范霍夫奇点的平带，位于费米能级以下约 1.1 eV，表明强电子相关效应。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: kagome 晶格已成为研究奇异量子相的有前途的平台。然而，在元素材料中实现单原子层戈薇晶格仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们介绍了线图外延，这是一种能够原子级合成goldene的新方法，goldene是排列在kagome晶格中的单层元素金原子。通过扫描隧道显微镜/光谱学 (STM/STS) 和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算，我们证明了 Kagome Goldene 的形成，其特征是具有范霍夫奇点的平带，位于费米能级以下约 1.1 eV，表明强电子相关效应。值得注意的是，平带在金色纳米薄片的锯齿形边缘处被破坏，揭示了显着的边缘效应。此外，我们的计算表明，goldene 和下面的 Au2Ge 衬底之间的弱层间相互作用通过邻近效应产生双狄拉克节点线。这些发现不仅提供了构建元素戈薇晶格的新策略，而且还提供了制造和控制线图材料的通用框架。这项研究推进了对强相关性驱动的量子相的探索以及下一代量子技术的材料设计。

full_list.title_en: Lattice Symmetry Remnants in Spatial and Temporal Entanglement of Quantum Critical Spin Chains
full_list.title_zh: 量子临界自旋链时空纠缠中的晶格对称残余
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.31676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum critical lattice models carry universal information beyond the bulk data of their infrared conformal field theory (CFT): microscopic lattice symmetries constrain how the CFT is realized. We probe these remnants through the spatial and temporal entanglement of two Euclidean-evolved states from the same critical model. In the finite-length scaling regime, a conformal boundary encodes the long-distance effect of the short-range initial state, and boundary CFT (BCFT) organizes the universal low-lying entanglement spectrum. We formulate the temporal state as a uniform infinite matrix product state evolved by a symmetry-preserving infinite matrix product operator, using a local factorization regular even at arbitrarily small Trotter steps. For the Ising and three-state Potts chains, whose relevant symmetries are onsite, the spatial and temporal constructions approach the same BCFT structure; varying the initial state engineers conformal boundaries distinguishable spectroscopically. The spin-1/2 XXZ chain instead realizes a Lieb--Schultz--Mattis (LSM) constraint between internal U(1) symmetry and one-site translation. A U(1)-preserving short-range spatial state accommodates it through a doubled unit cell and inequivalent entanglement cuts, whereas the temporal state remains uniform along Euclidean time. Successive spatial transfer steps pump the temporal entanglement spectrum between translation-related Dirichlet sectors, equivalently between integer and half-integer compact-boson zero modes. Breaking U(1) removes both the zero mode and the alternation. Continued evolution at fixed bond dimension crosses over from the finite-length BCFT regime to a finite-entanglement regime generated by symmetry-allowed relevant deformations. Thus microscopic symmetry and anomaly data remain visible in universal entanglement by constraining the boundary realization of the infrared CFT.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量子临界晶格模型携带的通用信息超出了红外共形场理论 (CFT) 的大量数据：微观晶格对称性限制了 CFT 的实现方式。我们通过同一临界模型中两个欧几里得演化态的空间和时间纠缠来探测这些残余物。在有限长度尺度体系中，共形边界编码了短程初始状态的长距离效应，边界CFT（BCFT）组织了通用的低位纠缠谱。我们将时间状态表示为由保对称性无限矩阵乘积算子演变而来的统一无限矩阵乘积状态，即使在任意小的 Trotter 步长下也使用局部因式分解正则。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 量子临界晶格模型携带的通用信息超出了红外共形场理论 (CFT) 的大量数据：微观晶格对称性限制了 CFT 的实现方式。我们通过同一临界模型中两个欧几里得演化态的空间和时间纠缠来探测这些残余物。在有限长度尺度体系中，共形边界编码了短程初始状态的长距离效应，边界CFT（BCFT）组织了通用的低位纠缠谱。我们将时间状态表示为由保对称性无限矩阵乘积算子演变而来的统一无限矩阵乘积状态，即使在任意小的 Trotter 步长下也使用局部因式分解正则。对于伊辛链和三态 Potts 链，其相关对称性在现场，空间和时间结构接近相同的 BCFT 结构；改变初始状态工程师可以通过光谱区分共形边界。相反，自旋 1/2 XXZ 链实现了内部 U(1) 对称性和单点平移之间的 Lieb--Schultz--Mattis (LSM) 约束。保留 U(1) 的短程空间状态通过双晶胞和不等价的纠缠切割来容纳它，而时间状态沿着欧几里德时间保持一致。连续的空间转移步骤泵送平移相关狄利克雷扇区之间的时间纠缠谱，相当于整数和半整数紧致玻色子零模式之间的时间纠缠谱。破坏 U(1) 会消除零模式和交替。固定键维数的持续演化从有限长度 BCFT 体系过渡到由对称允许的相关变形生成的有限纠缠体系。因此，通过限制红外 CFT 的边界实现，微观对称性和异常数据在通用纠缠中保持可见。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《量子临界自旋链时空纠缠中的晶格对称残余》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Low-energy collective electronic excitations in a gold monolayer
full_list.title_zh: 金单层中的低能集体电子激发
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.31805v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The low-energy plasmonic properties of a free-standing Au(111) monolayer, frequently referred to as goldene, are investigated by time-dependent density functional theory in the random phase approximation. In the evaluation of dielectric and loss functions the first-principle band structure characterized by a single s-p energy band at the Fermi level is taken into account. In this system with apparently simple band structure around the Fermi surface the calculations show the presence, besides the standard two-dimensional (2D) plasmon mode, at even lower energies of three anomalous branches in the momentum-energy region usually assigned to incoherent electron-hole pairs. This is an unexpected result since the electronic system of the gold monolayer is characterized by a single energy band crossing the Fermi level. The dispersion of these anomalous plasmonic branches is strongly anisotropic in-plane and gapless. A general feature is that at small in-plane momentum transfers the modes have a sound-like dispersion in certain momentum directions. We rely the appearance of these anomalous modes to a notable deviation of the Fermi surface of a gold monolayer from a circular shape. As a result of its almost perfect hexagon shape, there is possibility to realize in a it single electronic energy band a scenario of a multi-component electron system with the carrier groups moving with different Fermi velocities in certain momentum directions. The found modes correspond to the out-of-phase charge oscillations of the carriers at different sides of the hexagonal Fermi surface. Hence our work presents evidence how in a metal system with apparently simple band structure around the Fermi level its shape can result in conversion of single-particle charge excitations into collective charge excitations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 独立式 Au(111) 单层（通常称为 Goldene）的低能等离子体特性是通过随机相位近似中的时间相关密度泛函理论进行研究的。在评估介电和损耗函数时，考虑了以费米能级单个 s-p 能带为特征的第一原理能带结构。在这个费米表面周围具有明显简单的能带结构的系统中，计算表明，除了标准二维（2D）等离子体激元模式之外，在通常分配给不相干电子空穴对的动量能量区域中还存在能量更低的三个异常分支。这是一个意想不到的结果，因为金单层的电子系统的特征是跨越费米能级的单个能带。

full_list.title_en: Majorana Edge-to-bound State Transition in Interferometric Superconductor Rings
full_list.title_zh: 干涉超导环中马约拉纳边到界的状态转变
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Manipulating flux quanta in topological superconductors is central to vortex braiding in quantum computing. Their interferometric superconducting rings can host either topologically protected edge states with fluxes confined inside the central hollow area or vortex bound states in flux cores at the annulus walls. Here we demonstrate a strategy to drive topological edge states into vortex bound states by tuning the relative scale of vortex size and annulus width in nano-ring interferometric device on 2M-WS₂ topological superconductor. Near its superconducting transition where the coherence length exceeds the annulus width, Little-Parks oscillations exhibit expected periods for flux bundles in ring-center, consistent with edge states residing at inner and outer rims of the annulus. Upon cooling, where the coherence length shrinks below the annulus width, the unexpectedly increased oscillation period reflects multiple fluxes distributed along annulus region in flux necklace configuration, implying a transition from extended edge states to localized vortex bound states. Ginzburg-Landau simulations and local density-of-states calculations with Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations reveal that large values for both Ginzburg-Landau parameter and flux-pinning energy are vital for such a transition. Our findings provide a novel strategy for understanding flux manipulation towards flux braiding and topological quantum computing.
full_list.abstract_zh: 操纵拓扑超导体中的通量量子是量子计算中涡旋编织的核心。它们的干涉超导环可以承载拓扑保护的边缘态（通量被限制在中心空心区域内）或在环壁处的通量核心中的涡旋束缚态。在这里，我们演示了一种通过调整 2M-WS2 拓扑超导体纳米环干涉装置中涡旋尺寸和环带宽度的相对尺度来将拓扑边缘态驱动为涡旋束缚态的策略。在相干长度超过环带宽度的超导转变附近，Little-Parks 振荡表现出环中心磁通束的预期周期，与环带内缘和外缘处的边缘态一致。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 操纵拓扑超导体中的通量量子是量子计算中涡旋编织的核心。它们的干涉超导环可以承载拓扑保护的边缘态（通量被限制在中心空心区域内）或在环壁处的通量核心中的涡旋束缚态。在这里，我们演示了一种通过调整 2M-WS2 拓扑超导体纳米环干涉装置中涡旋尺寸和环带宽度的相对尺度来将拓扑边缘态驱动为涡旋束缚态的策略。在相干长度超过环带宽度的超导转变附近，Little-Parks 振荡表现出环中心磁通束的预期周期，与环带内缘和外缘处的边缘态一致。冷却后，相干长度收缩到环空宽度以下，意外增加的振荡周期反映了沿磁通项链配置的环空区域分布的多个通量，这意味着从扩展边缘态到局部涡旋束缚态的转变。 Ginzburg-Landau 模拟和使用 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方程进行的局域态密度计算表明，Ginzburg-Landau 参数和通量钉扎能量的大值对于这种转变至关重要。我们的研究结果为理解磁通编织和拓扑量子计算的磁通操纵提供了一种新颖的策略。

full_list.title_en: Material criteria for angular-momentum transfer from twisted photons to photoelectrons
full_list.title_zh: 从扭曲光子到光电子的角动量转移的材料标准
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32121v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the material requirements for transferring the total-angular-momentum (TAM) projection of a twisted photon to the orbital angular momentum (OAM) of a photoelectron emitted from an n-type semiconductor surface. Within a single-valley effective-mass model of surface photoemission, we calculate OAM-resolved spectra for GaAs, InSb, InAs₀.₃₄Sb₀.₆₆, and Hg₀.₇₆Cd₀.₂₄Te irradiated by twisted photons with Laguerre--Gaussian--like momentum profile. The OAM transfer is characterized by the mean electron OAM, its root-mean-squared width, and the fraction of electrons with OAM-projection equal to the photon TAM-projection. Efficient transfer requires the transverse momentum of the conduction electron to be much smaller than the transverse momentum width of the photon, which favors low temperatures, small conduction-band effective masses, and shallow donor levels. GaAs is less favorable within the present model because of its larger effective mass and deeper donor levels. We also discuss the demanding photon-wave packet parameters, possible extensions to Dirac and Weyl semimetals, and post-emission OAM selection. Although the generation of vortex electrons with a vanishing OAM uncertainty via photoemission seems challenging, we argue that it is still possible to generate single-electron vortex states with a finite OAM dispersion.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了将扭曲光子的总角动量 (TAM) 投影转移到 n 型半导体表面发射的光电子的轨道角动量 (OAM) 的材料要求。在表面光电子发射的单谷有效质量模型中，我们计算了受到类似拉盖尔高斯动量分布的扭曲光子照射的 GaAs、InSb、InAs₀.₃₄Sb₀.₆₆ 和 Hg₀.₇₆Cd₀.2₄Te 的 OAM 分辨光谱。 OAM 转移的特征在于平均电子 OAM、其均方根宽度以及 OAM 投影等于光子 TAM 投影的电子比例。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了将扭曲光子的总角动量 (TAM) 投影转移到 n 型半导体表面发射的光电子的轨道角动量 (OAM) 的材料要求。在表面光电子发射的单谷有效质量模型中，我们计算了受到类似拉盖尔高斯动量分布的扭曲光子照射的 GaAs、InSb、InAs₀.₃₄Sb₀.₆₆ 和 Hg₀.₇₆Cd₀.2₄Te 的 OAM 分辨光谱。 OAM 转移的特征在于平均电子 OAM、其均方根宽度以及 OAM 投影等于光子 TAM 投影的电子比例。有效的转移要求传导电子的横向动量远小于光子的横向动量宽度，这有利于低温、小导带有效质量和浅施主能级。 GaAs 在当前模型中不太受欢迎，因为它具有较大的有效质量和更深的施主能级。我们还讨论了要求严格的光子波包参数、狄拉克和韦尔半金属的可能扩展以及发射后 OAM 选择。尽管通过光电子产生具有消失的 OAM 不确定性的涡旋电子似乎具有挑战性，但我们认为仍然有可能产生具有有限 OAM 色散的单电子涡旋态。

full_list.title_en: Modification of optical properties in ultrathin ALD-grown NbN layers using oxygen plasma treatment
full_list.title_zh: 使用氧等离子体处理修改超薄 ALD 生长的 NbN 层的光学特性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32553v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: NbN thin films with a nominal thickness of 10 nm were grown by atomic layer deposition (ALD) on Al₂O₃-buffered Si substrates and treated with oxygen plasma for 0 s (untreated), 20 s, 40 s, and 60 s to investigate oxygen-induced changes in their optical properties. Spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) measurements were performed before and after oxygen plasma treatment over the ultraviolet-visible-near-infrared (1.24-6.20 eV) and infrared (0.041-0.827 eV) spectral ranges. Film thickness determined by X-ray reflectivity (XRR) was used as a fixed parameter in the optical modeling to extract the dielectric function, optical constants, and effective free-carrier concentration. We observed the emergence of a distinct absorption feature near 4.9 eV following oxygen plasma treatment, consistent with the oxidation of the NbN surface and the resulting change in its optical properties. Increasing the treatment time from 0 to 60 s reduced the effective carrier concentration from 1.20 × 10²² to 1.03 × 10²² cm⁻³ and the effective carrier mobility from 2.44 to 2.27 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹. The obtained results provide a basis for understanding the effects of oxygen plasma treatment on NbN thin films.
full_list.abstract_zh: 通过原子层沉积 (ALD) 在 Al2O3 缓冲的 Si 基板上生长标称厚度为 10 nm 的 NbN 薄膜，并用氧等离子体处理 0 秒（未处理）、20 秒、40 秒和 60 秒，以研究氧引起的光学性能变化。在氧等离子体处理之前和之后，在紫外-可见-近红外（1.24-6.20 eV）和红外（0.041-0.827 eV）光谱范围内进行光谱椭圆光度（SE）测量。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 通过原子层沉积 (ALD) 在 Al2O3 缓冲的 Si 基板上生长标称厚度为 10 nm 的 NbN 薄膜，并用氧等离子体处理 0 秒（未处理）、20 秒、40 秒和 60 秒，以研究氧引起的光学性能变化。在氧等离子体处理之前和之后，在紫外-可见-近红外（1.24-6.20 eV）和红外（0.041-0.827 eV）光谱范围内进行光谱椭圆光度（SE）测量。由 X 射线反射率 (XRR) 确定的薄膜厚度被用作光学建模中的固定参数，以提取介电函数、光学常数和有效自由载流子浓度。我们观察到氧等离子体处理后在 4.9 eV 附近出现了明显的吸收特征，这与 NbN 表面的氧化及其光学性质的变化一致。将处理时间从 0 秒增加到 60 秒，有效载流子浓度从 1.20 × 1022 cm-3 降低到 1.03 × 1022 cm-3，有效载流子迁移率从 2.44 cm2 V-1 s-1 降低到 2.27 cm2 V-1 s-1。所得结果为理解氧等离子体处理对NbN薄膜的影响提供了基础。

full_list.title_en: Nano-ARPES observation of a flat band at the barM point in 2.4deg twisted bilayer graphene
full_list.title_zh: 纳米 ARPES 观察 2.4 度扭曲双层石墨烯中 barM 点处的平带
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The emergence of flat bands in twisted bilayer graphene at the so-called magic angle reveals a range of intriguing phases, such as superconductivity and Mott insulating states, resulting from electrons entering a correlated state. This establishes twisted bilayer graphene as an excellent platform for exploring correlation effects in many-body phases and across various twist angles. However, in most cases, the twist angle is not an easy parameter to control because it exhibits structural instabilities such as relaxation and reconstruction that reduce the correlation effects. Here, we report the unexpected appearance of a flat band at the barM point far from the Fermi level in a 2.4deg twisted bilayer graphene, directly visualized by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. Our work is the first observation of flat bands away from the barK point in twisted bilayer graphene and highlights the need to probe the entire Brillouin zone to fully capture electronic states in twisted structures.
full_list.abstract_zh: 扭曲双层石墨烯中所谓魔角的平带的出现揭示了一系列有趣的相，例如由电子进入相关态而产生的超导性和莫特绝缘态。这使得扭曲双层石墨烯成为探索多体相和不同扭曲角度的相关效应的绝佳平台。然而，在大多数情况下，扭转角并不是一个容易控制的参数，因为它表现出结构不稳定性，例如松弛和重构，从而降低了相关效应。在这里，我们报告了在 2.4 度扭曲双层石墨烯中远离费米能级的 barM 点处意外出现的平带，通过角分辨光电子能谱直接可视化。

full_list.title_en: Open quantum spin chains with non-reciprocity: a theoretical approach based on the time-dependent generalized Gibbs ensemble
full_list.title_zh: 具有非互易性的开放量子自旋链：基于时间依赖性广义吉布斯系综的理论方法
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.08606v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study an open quantum spin chain with non-reciprocal dissipation using a theoretical approach known as time-dependent generalized Gibbs ensemble. In the regime of weak dissipation the system is fully characterized by its rapidity distribution and we derive a closed set of coupled differential equations governing their time evolution. We check the accuracy of this theory by benchmarking the results against numerical simulations. Using this framework we are able to compute both the magnetization density and current dynamics, identifying some relations between the two. The problem of the anomalous power-law exponents identified in a previous work is discussed. Our work constitutes a theoretical approach that is able to describe the physics of non-reciprocal open quantum spin chains beyond analyses based on non-interacting fermions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们使用称为时间相关广义吉布斯系综的理论方法研究具有非互易耗散的开放量子自旋链。在弱耗散状态下，系统完全以其快速分布为特征，我们推导出一组控制其时间演化的闭耦合微分方程。我们通过将结果与数值模拟进行基准测试来检查该理论的准确性。使用这个框架，我们能够计算磁化强度和电流动力学，确定两者之间的一些关系。讨论了先前工作中发现的反常幂律指数问题。我们的工作构成了一种理论方法，能够描述非互易开放量子自旋链的物理现象，超越基于非相互作用费米子的分析。

full_list.summary: 我们使用称为时间相关广义吉布斯系综的理论方法研究具有非互易耗散的开放量子自旋链。在弱耗散状态下，系统完全以其快速分布为特征，我们推导出一组控制其时间演化的闭耦合微分方程。我们通过将结果与数值模拟进行基准测试来检查该理论的准确性。使用这个框架，我们能够计算磁化强度和电流动力学，确定两者之间的一些关系。讨论了先前工作中发现的反常幂律指数问题。我们的工作构成了一种理论方法，能够描述非互易开放量子自旋链的物理现象，超越基于非相互作用费米子的分析。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《具有非互易性的开放量子自旋链：基于时间依赖性广义吉布斯系综的理论方法》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Optical signatures of Rashba--Dresselhaus coupling across Franz--Keldysh and Landau regimes in two-dimensional semiconductors
full_list.title_zh: 二维半导体中 Franz-Keldysh 和 Landau 体系中 Rashba-Dresselhaus 耦合的光学特征
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.31843v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a unified theory of the interband optical response of a two-dimensional semiconductor with simultaneous Rashba and Dresselhaus spin-orbit couplings in electric and magnetic fields. In crossed fields, the in-plane electric field generates an effective spin-orbit drift field that modifies the Landau spectrum and spinor states, while at zero magnetic field the problem maps onto Landau--Zener spin dynamics.At zero external fields, the total joint density of states above the band gap remains unchanged, while characteristic subgap structures appear. Pure Rashba coupling produces an inverse square root singularity, whereas a finite Dresselhaus term gives a step and a logarithmic peak, allowing the two couplings to be distinguished optically. At zero magnetic field, the Franz--Keldysh response shows a crossover from diabatic to adiabatic spin dynamics as the electric field is reduced. In the weak-field Rashba regime, the field-free singularity becomes a finite peak whose height scales as mathcal E⁻¹/³ and whose position approaches E_g-Eᵣₘ SO, providing a direct measure of the Rashba energy. In a perpendicular magnetic field, spin-orbit coupling shifts and splits the Landau absorption lines and produces anticrossings without changing their total weights. The Rashba splitting changes from a sqrtB dependence at weak fields to a linear dependence at strong fields. Finally, in crossed electric and magnetic fields, the electric field broadens the Landau lines and drives a continuous crossover toward the Franz--Keldysh regime, while spin-orbit coupling produces opposite shifts and different widths for the two members of each doublet.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们开发了二维半导体带间光学响应的统一理论，在电场和磁场中同时存在 Rashba 和 Dresselhaus 自旋轨道耦合。在交叉场中，面内电场产生有效的自旋轨道漂移场，改变朗道谱和旋量态，而在零磁场下，问题映射到朗道-齐纳自旋动力学。在零外部场下，带隙上方的总态联合密度保持不变，同时出现特征子带隙结构。纯 Rashba 耦合产生反平方根奇点，而有限 Dresselhaus 项给出阶跃和对数峰值，从而可以在光学上区分这两个耦合。

full_list.title_en: Phonon evidence for a partial, re-entrant spin reorientation near room temperature in LaFe₁₋ₓNiₓO₃
full_list.title_zh: LaFe₁₋ₓNiₓO₃ 中室温附近部分重入自旋重新取向的声子证据
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.31725v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin reorientation near room temperature offers a route to controlling antiferromagnetic order, yet LaFeO3, which lacks a magnetic rare-earth ion, is generally expected to retain its spin orientation along the a axis below Tmathrm Napprox740~K. Here, we investigate LaFe₁₋ₓNiₓO₃ (x=0 and 0.1) using temperature-dependent magnetization and Raman spectroscopy over 200--400~K. Both compositions exhibit magnetic anomalies at 285.6 and 323~K, respectively, accompanied by correlated deviations of 12 Raman modes from their conventional anharmonic behavior. Principal component analysis and a global fitting approach reveal a common temperature-dependent phonon response, with mode-dependent amplitudes and signs. To interpret these anomalies, we develop a Landau-based spin-phonon coupling model describing complete, partial re-entrant, and incipient spin reorientation. Comparison with the experimental Raman profiles favors a partial, re-entrant rotation of the N'eel vector in both compositions, centered near 290~K. Ni substitution narrows the characteristic reorientation interval from approximately 116 to 84~K and enhances the magnetization anomaly by a factor of four. An additional feature near 262~K in LaFeO₃ is consistent with the Morin transition of trace α-Fe₂O₃. These findings suggest that partial spin reorientation can emerge without magnetic rare-earth ions and establish collective Raman phonon anomalies as a sensitive indirect probe of magnetic anisotropy changes in orthoferrites.
full_list.abstract_zh: 室温附近的自旋重新取向提供了控制反铁磁序的途径，但缺乏磁性稀土离子的 LaFeO3 通常预计会沿低于 Tmathrm Napprox740~K 的 a 轴保持其自旋取向。在这里，我们使用温度依赖性磁化强度和 200--400~K 范围内的拉曼光谱研究了 LaFe₁₋ₓNiₓO₃（x=0 和 0.1）。两种成分分别在 285.6 和 323~K 处表现出磁异常，并伴有 12 个拉曼模式与其传统非谐波行为的相关偏差。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 室温附近的自旋重新取向提供了控制反铁磁序的途径，但缺乏磁性稀土离子的 LaFeO3 通常预计会沿低于 Tmathrm Napprox740~K 的 a 轴保持其自旋取向。在这里，我们使用温度依赖性磁化强度和 200--400~K 范围内的拉曼光谱研究了 LaFe₁₋ₓNiₓO₃（x=0 和 0.1）。两种成分分别在 285.6 和 323~K 处表现出磁异常，并伴有 12 个拉曼模式与其传统非谐波行为的相关偏差。主成分分析和全局拟合方法揭示了常见的温度相关声子响应，具有模式相关的振幅和符号。为了解释这些异常现象，我们开发了一个基于朗道的自旋声子耦合模型，描述完全、部分重入和初期自旋重定向。与实验拉曼曲线的比较有利于两种组合物中 N'eel 矢量的部分重入旋转，中心在 290~K 附近。 Ni 替代将特征重取向区间从大约 116 缩小到 84~K，并将磁化异常增强四倍。 LaFeO₃ 中 262~K 附近的一个附加特征与微量 α-Fe2O₃ 的莫林跃迁一致。这些发现表明，部分自旋重新取向可以在没有磁性稀土离子的情况下出现，并建立集体拉曼声子异常作为正铁氧体磁各向异性变化的敏感间接探针。

full_list.title_en: Quantum Complexity and Stabilizer-State Expansions: From Pairing to Deformation in Fermionic Systems
full_list.title_zh: 量子复杂性和稳定态展开：从费米子系统中的配对到变形
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.31792v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding how collective phenomena such as pairing and deformation emerge in interacting fermionic systems, and how the correlations underlying them shape the resources required for their simulation, is a central challenge in many-body physics. We investigate various aspects of quantum complexity in a fermionic system exhibiting two main forms of collectivity, specifically deformation and pairing, through entanglement, non-stabilizerness, and fermionic non-Gaussianity. In the deformed phase, high entanglement coexists with low non-stabilizerness, while the superfluid pairing phase, by contrast, exhibits substantial multipartite entanglement and non-stabilizerness, together with maximal fermionic anti-flatness. In a second step we examine how to describe the phase diagram of the system in a classically scalable and symmetry-preserving way, by combining stabilizer-state expansion and variational basis optimization. A physics-guided decomposition of the Hamiltonian identifies the relevant stabilizer states, which can be constructed from graph states. A single stabilizer state captures the deformed phase to a large extent, and, although the number of stabilizer states required to describe the pairing phase grows exponentially with system size, a symmetry-preserving basis rotation yields a high-fidelity approximation using far fewer states. This rotated state can then serve as a practical starting point for quantum refinement.
full_list.abstract_zh: 了解配对和变形等集体现象如何在相互作用的费米子系统中出现，以及它们背后的相关性如何塑造模拟所需的资源，是多体物理学的一个核心挑战。我们通过纠缠、非稳定性和费米子非高斯性研究了费米子系统中量子复杂性的各个方面，该系统表现出两种主要的集体形式，特别是变形和配对。在变形相中，高纠缠度与低非稳定度共存，而相比之下，超流体配对相则表现出大量的多部分纠缠和非稳定度，以及最大的费米子反平坦性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 了解配对和变形等集体现象如何在相互作用的费米子系统中出现，以及它们背后的相关性如何塑造模拟所需的资源，是多体物理学的一个核心挑战。我们通过纠缠、非稳定性和费米子非高斯性研究了费米子系统中量子复杂性的各个方面，该系统表现出两种主要的集体形式，特别是变形和配对。在变形相中，高纠缠度与低非稳定度共存，而相比之下，超流体配对相则表现出大量的多部分纠缠和非稳定度，以及最大的费米子反平坦性。在第二步中，我们研究如何通过结合稳定器状态扩展和变分基优化，以经典的可扩展和对称性保持的方式描述系统的相图。哈密顿量的物理引导分解可识别相关的稳定器状态，这些状态可以从图状态构建。单个稳定器状态在很大程度上捕获变形相位，并且尽管描述配对相位所需的稳定器状态数量随着系统尺寸呈指数增长，但保持对称性的基础旋转使用少得多的状态产生高保真度近似。这种旋转状态可以作为量子细化的实际起点。
