full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《量子复杂性和稳定态展开：从费米子系统中的配对到变形》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Rationalizing charge transfer: a single-molecule case study across three distinct surfaces
full_list.title_zh: 合理化电荷转移：三个不同表面的单分子案例研究
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Organic molecules are versatile building blocks for the formation of complex low-dimensional nanostructures on surfaces. Recently, interest has grown in translating on-surface synthetic protocols from noble metal surfaces to insulating surfaces, which offer technological relevance, and to magnetic or superconducting surfaces, which offer new routes to correlated phases. It is important, therefore, to understand how these alternative surfaces may alter the properties of adsorbates through processes like charge transfer and screening. Evidence for charge transfer is often obtained experimentally via scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) and spectroscopy (STS), and theoretically via density functional theory (DFT). In this work, we systematically compare the properties of isolated macrocyclic emeraldine (Me₆) molecules on three different surfaces: metallic Au(111), a semiconducting ferromagnetic monolayer of FeCl₂, and a cleaved superconducting surface of bulk 2H-NbSe₂. We show that STS and DFT alone are insufficient to quantify charge transfer for these cases. Instead, we complement these methods with Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM) measurements and model Hamiltonian calculations to demonstrate that on Au(111) and FeCl₂, Me₆ molecules donate a single electron to the substrate, whereas on NbSe₂ two electrons are transferred from molecule to substrate. Our work provides insight into the interplay of charge transfer, screening, and molecule-substrate coupling, and develops experimental and theoretical methods for comparing the properties of adsorbates across different surfaces for future studies.
full_list.abstract_zh: 有机分子是用于在表面形成复杂的低维纳米结构的多功能构建块。最近，人们对将表面合成方案从贵金属表面转化为绝缘表面（提供技术相关性）以及磁性或超导表面（提供相关相的新途径）的兴趣日益浓厚。因此，了解这些替代表面如何通过电荷转移和筛选等过程改变吸附物的特性非常重要。电荷转移的证据通常通过扫描隧道显微镜 (STM) 和光谱学 (STS) 实验获得，理论上通过密度泛函理论 (DFT) 获得。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 有机分子是用于在表面形成复杂的低维纳米结构的多功能构建块。最近，人们对将表面合成方案从贵金属表面转化为绝缘表面（提供技术相关性）以及磁性或超导表面（提供相关相的新途径）的兴趣日益浓厚。因此，了解这些替代表面如何通过电荷转移和筛选等过程改变吸附物的特性非常重要。电荷转移的证据通常通过扫描隧道显微镜 (STM) 和光谱学 (STS) 实验获得，理论上通过密度泛函理论 (DFT) 获得。在这项工作中，我们系统地比较了三个不同表面上孤立的大环翠绿亚胺 (Me₆) 分子的特性：金属 Au(111)、FeCl2 的半导体铁磁单层和块体 2H-NbSe2 的劈裂超导表面。我们表明，仅 STS 和 DFT 不足以量化这些情况下的电荷转移。相反，我们用开尔文探针力显微镜 (KPFM) 测量和模型哈密顿计算来补充这些方法，以证明在 Au(111) 和 FeCl2 上，Me₆ 分子将单个电子贡献给基板，而在 NbSe2 上，两个电子从分子转移到基板。我们的工作提供了对电荷转移、筛选和分子-底物耦合之间相互作用的深入了解，并开发了实验和理论方法来比较不同表面上吸附物的特性，以供未来研究。

full_list.title_en: Resonant dielectric amplification of superconductivity at the FeSe:SrTiOT₃ interface
full_list.title_zh: FeSe:SrTiOT₃ 界面超导的谐振介电放大
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2508.09063v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Epitaxial monolayers of FeSe grown on SrTiO₃ (STO) and related polar substrates exhibit superconducting transition temperatures of 65-70 K, far above the ~8 K value of bulk FeSe. Although coupling to interfacial Fuchs-Kliewer (FK) phonons is widely believed to contribute to this enhancement, the apparent universality of high=T_c superconductivity across polar interfaces presents a striking puzzle. Here, we identify the lower-energy FK mode near 59 meV, associated with the bulk longitudinal optical resonance of STO, as a conduit through which the substrate dielectric response enhances pairing in FeSe. Within a phenomenological Migdal-Eliashberg framework, incorporating the measured dielectric response of STO selectively amplifies the pairing interaction near this resonance and raises the theoretical upper bound of T_c into the experimentally observed range. A similar enhancement is reproduced for FeSe on BaTiO₃, while related polar substrates such as TiO₂, LaFeO₃, and EuTiO3 possess the same key electrodynamic ingredients. We refer to this effect as resonant anti-shielding (RAS). More broadly, RAS identifies the bulk electrodynamic response of the substrate as a pairing amplifier, opening a route toward designing superconducting heterostructures through control of their dielectric environment.

full_list.title_en: SO(5) multicriticality in two-dimensional quantum magnets
full_list.title_zh: 二维量子磁体中的 SO(5) 多临界性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2405.06607v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We resolve the nature of the quantum phase transition between antiferromagnetic and valence-bond solid ground states in square-lattice spin-1/2 magnets - the putative deconfined quantum-critical point. Using quantum Monte Carlo simulations of J-Q models, in which Heisenberg exchange J competes with multi-spin interactions Qn formed by n singlet projectors, we demonstrate first-order discontinuities increasing with n. For n=2 and n=3, the first-order signatures are very weak and we extract universal scaling dimensions of a proximate multicritical point. Their values coincide closely with known bounds for an SO(5) symmetric conformal field theory (CFT) containing a relevant SO(5) singlet operator that destabilizes the generic deconfined critical point. We characterize the emergent SO(5) symmetry by its scaling dimensions of the leading irrelevant perturbations. Using the J-Q2-Q6 model, we tune the transition from weak to stronger first-order and find scaling of the coexisting order parameters with a large exponent beta ~ 0.85, in agreement with the relevant scaling dimensions of the multicritical point. The exponent that had previously been identified with the correlation length does not have a corresponding CFT level, and we explain it as pseudo-critical length scale of bubbles of one phase inside the other that are compressed in size by an SO(5)-violating irrelevant repulsive interaction between the two order parameters. The bubble scale reflects a hierarchy of excitation gaps generated by the SO(5) perturbation in the neighborhood of the first-order transition, akin to a Higgs mechanism. We argue that the multicritical point is the tip of a gapless spin liquid phase in frustrated Heisenberg models into which the J-Q models can be deformed, but the spin liquid, and perhaps the multicritical point itself, exist outside the regime amenable to sign-free simulations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们解决了方晶格自旋 1/2 磁体中反铁磁和价键固体基态之间量子相变的本质 - 假定的去限制量子临界点。使用 J-Q 模型的量子蒙特卡罗模拟，其中海森堡交换 J 与 n 个单重投影仪形成的多自旋相互作用 Qn 竞争，我们证明了一阶不连续性随 n 增加。对于 n=2 和 n=3，一阶特征非常弱，我们提取邻近多临界点的通用缩放维度。它们的值与 SO(5) 对称共形场论 (CFT) 的已知边界紧密一致，该边界包含相关的 SO(5) 单重态算子，该算子会破坏通用解限临界点的稳定性。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《二维量子磁体中的 SO(5) 多临界性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Solution-phase fluorination of nanodiamond: near-surface NV⁻ activation and spin relaxation
full_list.title_zh: 纳米金刚石的溶液相氟化：近表面 NV⁻ 激活和自旋弛豫
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.06605v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Nanodiamonds hosting luminescent point defects, known as fluorescent nanodiamonds (FND), are a leading platform for quantum technology. The nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centre is the most intensively studied of these; its negatively charged state (NV⁻) can serve as a qubit at room temperature, and its stability is governed by surface functional groups. We present two solution-phase fluorination routes for stabilising NV⁻: direct C-F bond formation by decarboxylation with xenon difluoride via a radical mechanism, and the Balz-Schiemann reaction, which replaces surface amino groups with fluorine. The two routes were compared by infrared, X-ray photoelectron, energy-dispersive X-ray, Raman and photoluminescence spectroscopy. Both gave a high NV⁻ fraction, up to sim85% on average, which to our knowledge is among the highest reported for surface-terminated nanodiamonds of this size and, in particular, for fluorine termination. We attribute the stabilisation to the fluorination treatment, which removes acceptor-like carboxyl groups and forms C-F bonds that give the surface a positive electron affinity. Frequency-domain relaxometry shows that the fluorinated particles retain a long spin-lattice relaxation time, 733±56 and 712±20 μs for the XeF₂ and Balz-Schiemann routes, several times the values reported for commercial HPHT nanodiamonds, although shorter than the 1173±123 μs of the as-received material. Fluorination thus activates near-surface NV⁻ centres, which dominate relaxometric sensing, at the cost of a moderate shortening of T₁.
full_list.abstract_zh: 具有发光点缺陷的纳米金刚石，称为荧光纳米金刚石 (FND)，是量子技术的领先平台。氮空位（NV）中心是其中研究最深入的；其带负电的状态（NV⁻）可以在室温下充当量子位，其稳定性受表面官能团的控制。我们提出了两种稳定 NV⁻ 的溶液相氟化途径：通过自由基机制用二氟化氙脱羧直接形成 C-F 键，以及用氟取代表面氨基的 Balz-Schiemann 反应。通过红外、X射线光电子、能量色散X射线、拉曼和光致发光光谱对这两种路线进行了比较。

full_list.title_en: Multifractal Magnons Around Localized Defects
full_list.title_zh: 局部缺陷周围的多重分形磁振子
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.32457v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multifractal wavefunctions fluctuate over a hierarchy of spatial scales, remaining spatially extended while exhibiting strongly nonuniform structure. We show that magnons in otherwise crystalline two-dimensional magnets can exhibit such behavior on mesoscopic scales, without disorder or quasiperiodicity. A localized defect can mix discrete groups of nearly degenerate magnon states in a finite sample, generating multiscale interference patterns and multifractal wavefunctions. We demonstrate this mechanism for both a simple spin defect and topological magnetic skyrmions. Large-scale spin-wave calculations for skyrmions in chiral and frustrated magnets reveal clear multifractal diagnostics over the full accessible range of system sizes of above-gap modes. Crucially, skyrmions make these states experimentally observable by hybridizing them with magnetically active internal deformation modes, which gives a subset of the multifractal states a nonzero magnetic dipole moment. These states can therefore be excited by uniform ac fields and remain distinguishable at realistic frequency resolution, providing a direct route to observing mesoscopic magnon multifractality.
full_list.abstract_zh: 多重分形波函数在空间尺度层次上波动，保持空间扩展，同时表现出强烈的不均匀结构。我们证明，其他晶体二维磁体中的磁振子可以在介观尺度上表现出这种行为，而没有无序或准周期性。局部缺陷可以在有限样本中混合离散的近简并磁振子态组，生成多尺度干涉图案和多重分形波函数。我们针对简单的自旋缺陷和拓扑磁性斯格明子证明了这种机制。对手性磁体和受挫磁体中斯格明子的大规模自旋波计算揭示了在带隙上方模式的整个系统尺寸范围内清晰的多重分形诊断。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 多重分形波函数在空间尺度层次上波动，保持空间扩展，同时表现出强烈的不均匀结构。我们证明，其他晶体二维磁体中的磁振子可以在介观尺度上表现出这种行为，而没有无序或准周期性。局部缺陷可以在有限样本中混合离散的近简并磁振子态组，生成多尺度干涉图案和多重分形波函数。我们针对简单的自旋缺陷和拓扑磁性斯格明子证明了这种机制。对手性磁体和受挫磁体中斯格明子的大规模自旋波计算揭示了在带隙上方模式的整个系统尺寸范围内清晰的多重分形诊断。至关重要的是，斯格明子通过将这些状态与磁活性内部变形模式混合，使这些状态可以在实验上观察到，从而为多重分形状态的子集提供非零磁偶极矩。因此，这些状态可以通过均匀的交流场激发，并在实际频率分辨率下保持可区分，为观察介观磁振子多重分形提供了直接途径。

research_direction_note: 本日文献与团队研究的交集主要集中在自由能面和热力学积分/采样、电子—声子耦合与输运、分子动力学与有限温度轨迹、密度泛函理论和电子结构计算，并落到晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系、缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学、声子、有限温度和输运性质、带电缺陷、缺陷形成能、陷阱态和器件退化。对现有工作最直接的价值是提供可复用的表示、采样或验证流程，而不是替代具体材料体系的物理判断。后续筛选应优先核对原文数据是否包含结构、能量、力、应力、极化、自旋或有限温度轨迹，再决定是否迁移到铁电、磁性、缺陷和外场驱动模拟。

core_items.title_en: Contrastive Regularization of Machine Learning Potentials
core_items.title_zh: 机器学习潜力的对比正则化
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2606.31660v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Machine learning models are increasingly trained as regressors and then deployed as generators, from language models to learned simulators. In this setting, accuracy on held-out data says little about the distribution a model produces when it is sampled. We study this problem where the correct distribution is fixed by first principles, in machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) trained by minimizing the mean squared error (MSE) on density functional theory (DFT) energies and forces, then used to run molecular simulations. The MSE never constrains the Boltzmann distribution that the potential defines, so an MLIP can match held-out DFT data and still drift, when sampled, into spurious minima that corrupt its thermodynamics. Building on the variational principle of statistical physics, we introduce Contrastive Regularized MSE (CRMSE), a post-training step in which the potential acts as its own energy-based model and learns to reproduce the distribution it generates, without any new DFT data. On molecules from the MD17 benchmark, CRMSE restores physical sampling and recovers DFT free-energy profiles, while keeping energy and force errors within chemical accuracy. Our results suggest that a model meant to be sampled must be trained on the distribution it produces, not only for pointwise accuracy.
core_items.abstract_zh: 机器学习模型越来越多地被训练为回归器，然后部署为生成器，从语言模型到学习模拟器。在这种情况下，保留数据的准确性几乎不能说明模型在采样时产生的分布。我们研究这个问题，其中正确的分布是由第一原理确定的，在机器学习原子间势（MLIP）中，通过最小化密度泛函理论（DFT）能量和力的均方误差（MSE）来训练，然后用于运行分子模拟。 MSE 永远不会限制势所定义的玻尔兹曼分布，因此 MLIP 可以匹配保留的 DFT 数据，并且在采样时仍然会漂移到破坏其热力学的虚假最小值。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习模型越来越多地被训练为回归器，然后部署为生成器，从语言模型到学习模拟器。在这种情况下，保留数据的准确性几乎不能说明模型在采样时产生的分布。我们研究这个问题，其中正确的分布是由第一原理确定的，在机器学习原子间势（MLIP）中，通过最小化密度泛函理论（DFT）能量和力的均方误差（MSE）来训练，然后用于运行分子模拟。 MSE 永远不会限制势所定义的玻尔兹曼分布，因此 MLIP 可以匹配保留的 DFT 数据，并且在采样时仍然会漂移到破坏其热力学的虚假最小值。基于统计物理学的变分原理，我们引入了对比正则化 MSE (CRMSE)，这是一个训练后步骤，其中势充当其自己的基于能量的模型，并学习重现其生成的分布，而无需任何新的 DFT 数据。对于 MD17 基准的分子，CRMSE 恢复物理采样并恢复 DFT 自由能分布，同时将能量和力误差保持在化学精度范围内。我们的结果表明，要采样的模型必须对其产生的分布进行训练，而不仅仅是为了逐点精度。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：机器学习势与原子级动力学, 密度泛函理论和电子结构计算, 热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

core_items.title_en: AtomMOF: All-Atom Flow Matching for MOF-Adsorbate Structure Prediction
core_items.title_zh: AtomMOF：用于 MOF 吸附结构预测的全原子流匹配
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2602.07351v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) are promising materials for applications such as direct air capture, where performance depends on how adsorbates bind within the framework. Accurately predicting MOF-adsorbate configurations is therefore important for screening candidate materials. However, traditional approaches are computationally expensive and require a known host structure, while existing generative models rely on rigid-body assumptions and do not explicitly model adsorbates. We introduce AtomMOF, a scalable all-atom flow-matching model that jointly predicts MOF-adsorbate structures from discrete building blocks and adsorbates. Built on a Diffusion Transformer with a building block-based pairwise attention bias, AtomMOF operates in an unconstrained all-atom space and exhibits clear scaling behavior. To improve the structural validity of flexible all-atom models, we also propose Feynman-Kac (FK) steering with machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs). On the BW dataset, AtomMOF achieves a 58.17% relative increase in match rate and a 31.84% relative reduction in RMSD compared with prior work. MLIP-guided steering further improves validity by 28.7% and reduces formation energy error by 86.5%. On ODAC25, AtomMOF generates adsorption configurations faster than GCMC and, when combined with MLIP relaxation, identifies lower-energy configurations than those in the reference dataset.
core_items.abstract_zh: 金属有机框架（MOF）是用于直接空气捕获等应用的有前景的材料，其性能取决于吸附物在框架内的结合方式。因此，准确预测 MOF 吸附物构型对于筛选候选材料非常重要。然而，传统方法的计算成本很高，并且需要已知的主体结构，而现有的生成模型依赖于刚体假设，并且没有明确地模拟吸附物。我们引入了 AtomMOF，这是一种可扩展的全原子流匹配模型，可以从离散的构建块和吸附物中联合预测 MOF 吸附物结构。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 金属有机框架（MOF）是用于直接空气捕获等应用的有前景的材料，其性能取决于吸附物在框架内的结合方式。因此，准确预测 MOF 吸附物构型对于筛选候选材料非常重要。然而，传统方法的计算成本很高，并且需要已知的主体结构，而现有的生成模型依赖于刚体假设，并且没有明确地模拟吸附物。我们引入了 AtomMOF，这是一种可扩展的全原子流匹配模型，可以从离散的构建块和吸附物中联合预测 MOF 吸附物结构。 AtomMOF 建立在具有基于构建块的成对注意力偏差的扩散变压器之上，在不受约束的全原子空间中运行，并表现出清晰的缩放行为。为了提高灵活全原子模型的结构有效性，我们还提出了具有机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的 Feynman-Kac（FK）转向。在 BW 数据集上，与之前的工作相比，AtomMOF 的匹配率相对提高了 58.17%，RMSD 相对降低了 31.84%。 MLIP引导的转向进一步将有效性提高了28.7%，并将地层能量误差降低了86.5%。在 ODAC25 上，AtomMOF 比 GCMC 更快地生成吸附构型，并且与 MLIP 弛豫结合使用时，可识别比参考数据集中的能量更低的构型。
core_items.summary: 金属有机框架（MOF）是用于直接空气捕获等应用的有前景的材料，其性能取决于吸附物在框架内的结合方式。因此，准确预测 MOF 吸附物构型对于筛选候选材料非常重要。然而，传统方法的计算成本很高，并且需要已知的主体结构，而现有的生成模型依赖于刚体假设，并且没有明确地模拟吸附物。我们引入了 AtomMOF，这是一种可扩展的全原子流匹配模型，可以从离散的构建块和吸附物中联合预测 MOF 吸附物结构。
core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《AtomMOF：用于 MOF 吸附结构预测的全原子流匹配》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Physics consistent conditional flow matching model as a plasma physics surrogate model
core_items.title_zh: 作为等离子体物理替代模型的物理一致条件流匹配模型
core_items.abstract: Physics-informed surrogate modeling for steady-state systems often struggles with data scarcity and optimization instabilities from soft penalty losses. Unlike prevailing physics-informed generative methods that rely on explicit, differentiable PDE residuals during training, our framework targets systems where closed-form governing equations are unavailable or non-differentiable. We introduce a unified continuous-time conditional flow matching (CFM) framework for surrogate modeling and sparse data assimilation, evaluated on low-temperature plasma dynamics. By combining data-dependent interpolants with dynamic masking, our approach handles unconditioned prediction and missing-data imputation within a single architecture. We replace standard velocity matching with a direct state-prediction ( -prediction) objective, eliminating variance-induced sampling inefficiencies in deterministic regimes. For inference, the formulation supports both time-dependent ODE integration (CFM- ) and an autonomous regime (CFM- ) that enables measurement conditioning via anchor substitution. Global conservation laws are enforced via post-hoc geometric projections rather than loss regularizers. Results show that both CFM variants achieve superior accuracy, sample efficiency under data scarcity, and raw physical consistency over standard regressors. Furthermore, macroscopic constraints alone yield negligible reductions in test error, confirming the necessity of a data-driven generative prior over the physical manifold.
core_items.abstract_zh: 稳态系统的基于物理的替代建模经常面临数据稀缺和软惩罚损失导致的优化不稳定的问题。与在训练过程中依赖于显式的、可微的 PDE 残差的主流物理生成方法不同，我们的框架针对的是闭式控制方程不可用或不可微的系统。我们引入了一个统一的连续时间条件流匹配（CFM）框架，用于替代建模和稀疏数据同化，并在低温等离子体动力学上进行评估。通过将数据相关插值与动态屏蔽相结合，我们的方法可以在单个架构中处理无条件预测和缺失数据插补。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 稳态系统的基于物理的替代建模经常面临数据稀缺和软惩罚损失导致的优化不稳定的问题。与在训练过程中依赖于显式的、可微的 PDE 残差的主流物理生成方法不同，我们的框架针对的是闭式控制方程不可用或不可微的系统。我们引入了一个统一的连续时间条件流匹配（CFM）框架，用于替代建模和稀疏数据同化，并在低温等离子体动力学上进行评估。通过将数据相关插值与动态屏蔽相结合，我们的方法可以在单个架构中处理无条件预测和缺失数据插补。我们用直接状态预测（-prediction）目标替换标准速度匹配，消除确定性机制中方差引起的采样效率低下。为了进行推理，该公式支持时间相关的 ODE 积分 (CFM- ) 和自主机制 (CFM- )，可通过锚点替换实现测量调节。全球守恒定律是通过事后几何投影而不是损失正则化器来执行的。结果表明，与标准回归器相比，两种 CFM 变体均实现了卓越的准确性、数据稀缺下的样本效率以及原始物理一致性。此外，仅宏观约束对测试误差的减少可以忽略不计，这证实了数据驱动的生成先验优于物理流形的必要性。

core_items.implication: 对《作为等离子体物理替代模型的物理一致条件流匹配模型》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Machine Learning Assisted Design of Complex and High Entropy Alloys by Hybrid HiPIMS/Pulsed-DC PVD Process for Low Carbon Energy Applications in Extreme Environments
core_items.title_zh: 通过混合 HiPIMS/脉冲直流 PVD 工艺机器学习辅助设计复杂高熵合金，用于极端环境中的低碳能源应用
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2608.01903v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Complex and high entropy alloys are attracting much attention currently thanks to their mechanical and corrosion resistance properties in harsh environments, in particular needed for carbon-free energy applications. However, their elaboration in bulk and in thin film form in a trial-and-error approach is impractical due to their complexity and the cocktail effect. The recent development of artificial intelligence brings a new possibility for their elaboration and adjustment of their properties. Firstly, we present an overview of Materials and data science research. Then we describe how DIADEM - French initiative for Materials and Data science convergence - tackles the development of innovative coatings for carbon-free energy applications (nuclear, high temperature electrolysis, ...) thanks to the development of a nationwide network of synthesis and characterization platforms - the DIADEM discovery hub. We describe in particular DIADEM-2D, an AI-driven Hybrid HiPIMS/Pulsed-DC PVD process using 4 cathodes in confocal combinatorial configuration. We present the high entropy alloy determination using data from the literature for corrosion resistance in molten salt media and nuclear accidental conditions. An element-independent model gathering deposition parameters and coating properties has been implemented allowing the design of protective coatings with a particular composition. We demonstrate the feasibility of this process and its accuracy.
core_items.abstract_zh: 复杂和高熵合金由于其在恶劣环境下的机械和耐腐蚀性能而备受关注，特别是无碳能源应用所需的性能。然而，由于其复杂性和鸡尾酒效应，通过试错方法以散装和薄膜形式进行加工是不切实际的。人工智能的最新发展为其属性的阐述和调整带来了新的可能性。首先，我们概述材料和数据科学研究。然后，我们描述了 DIADEM（法国材料和数据科学融合倡议）如何通过开发全国性的合成和表征平台网络（DIADEM 发现中心）来解决无碳能源应用（核、高温电解等）创新涂层的开发问题。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：自由能面和热力学积分/采样，以及晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《通过混合 HiPIMS/脉冲直流 PVD 工艺机器学习辅助设计复杂高熵合金，用于极端环境中的低碳能源应用》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Machine Learning Accelerated Simulation of Charge Regulation Effects
core_items.title_zh: 电荷调节效应的机器学习加速模拟
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.32713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many solvated materials, from nanoparticles to polyelectrolytes, acquire charge through the dissociation or association of surface groups, a phenomenon known as charge regulation (CR). Recent methods use hybrid charge regulation Monte Carlo (CR-MC)/molecular dynamics (MD) to evolve the system while dynamically adjusting charges on the surface groups. However, this approach is computationally expensive, as Monte Carlo sampling can be as costly as the accompanying MD. In this work, we introduce charge regulation machine learning (CR-ML), a graph attention network that predicts the ionization probability of every surface site from the instantaneous configuration, the dissociation constant of surface groups, and the solution conditions. We show that CR-ML reproduces the equilibrium conformations and degree of ionization obtained with CR-MC for a hydrophobic polyanion. We further test CR-ML on the more complex system of two nanoparticles mediated by a polyelectrolyte, where it accurately predicts the charge asymmetry that develops between the two particles. Across these systems, CR-ML updates charges an order of magnitude faster than CR-MC while accurately reproducing its equilibrium properties. This framework opens a path toward large-scale simulations of charge-regulating materials for understanding and designing their responsive behavior.
core_items.abstract_zh: 许多溶剂化材料，从纳米粒子到聚电解质，通过表面基团的解离或缔合获得电荷，这种现象称为电荷调节（CR）。最近的方法使用混合电荷调节蒙特卡罗（CR-MC）/分子动力学（MD）来进化系统，同时动态调整表面基团上的电荷。然而，这种方法的计算成本很高，因为蒙特卡罗采样的成本与随附的 MD 一样高。在这项工作中，我们引入了电荷调节机器学习（CR-ML），这是一种图注意力网络，可以根据瞬时构型、表面基团的解离常数和溶液条件来预测每个表面位点的电离概率。

core_items.title_en: Approximating the Gibbs Measure of Spherical Spin Glasses to Within o(N⁻¹/²) in the Replica Symmetric Phase
core_items.title_zh: 复制对称相中球形自旋玻璃的吉布斯测度近似于 o(N⁻1/2) 范围内
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.32649v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the magnetization vector of mixed spherical spin glasses in a weak external field, in the replica symmetric phase. We derive a coordinatewise expansion of the magnetization which includes the leading cubic correction to the quadratic approximation, with an error that is o(N⁻¹/²) per coordinate. We also prove a corresponding high-moment bound for the full vector. Finally, our companion paper applies these estimates to the effective Hamiltonian obtained by restricting a tilted spherical spin glass to a narrow band around a TAP critical point. The resulting sharp approximation is designed for applications in which normalized Wasserstein accuracy is insufficient, including total-variation sampling by stochastic localization.
core_items.abstract_zh: 我们研究了弱外场中混合球形自旋玻璃在复制对称相中的磁化矢量。我们推导出磁化强度的坐标展开，其中包括对二次近似的领先三次修正，每个坐标的误差为 o(N⁻1/2)。我们还证明了全向量的相应高矩界。最后，我们的配套论文将这些估计应用于通过将倾斜球形自旋玻璃限制在 TAP 临界点周围的窄带内而获得的有效哈密顿量。由此产生的锐近似是为归一化 Wasserstein 精度不足的应用而设计的，包括通过随机定位进行的总变异采样。

core_items.title_en: Electronic band structure reconstruction in Ni intercalated ZrTe₂
core_items.title_zh: Ni插层ZrTe2中的电子能带结构重建
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2601.02647v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The filling of the large van der Waals gap in Transition Metal Dichalcogenides (TMDs) often leads to lattice and electronic instabilities, which prelude the onset of a rich phenomenology. Motivated by previous results from macroscopic measurements, we investigate the electronic structure of the TMDs ZrTe₂ and Ni intercalated ZrTe₂ (NiₓZrTe₂, xapprox 0.05) employing angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES). We readily identify in NiₓZrTe₂ two flat bands, most likely associated with localized Ni-derived 3d-states, at about approx-0.7 eV and approx-1.2 eV in binding energy. More significantly, at low T, we identify an electronic structure reconstruction in NiₓZrTe₂, which halves the electronic periodicity along the kz direction. This is reminiscent of a commensurate band folding with wave-vector q=(0,0,π). A mean-field model for a charge density wave (CDW) transition driven by interband hole-hole interactions is solved with inputs from the experimentally determined electronic band structure. Comparison between theory and experiments unveils a CDW transition in NiₓZrTe₂, for which the gap opens above the Fermi level. Our findings invite further investigation into the structural properties of intercalated ZrTe₂.
core_items.abstract_zh: 过渡金属二硫化物（TMD）中大范德华能隙的填充通常会导致晶格和电子不稳定，从而预示着丰富的现象学的开始。受先前宏观测量结果的启发，我们采用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 研究了 TMD ZrTe2 和 Ni 插层 ZrTe2 (NiₓZrTe2, xapprox 0.05) 的电子结构。我们很容易在 NiₓZrTe2 中识别出两个平带，很可能与局域 Ni 衍生的 3d 态相关，结合能约为 0.7 eV 和约 1.2 eV。

core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《Ni插层ZrTe2中的电子能带结构重建》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Electronic structure of a persistent excitonic fluid far beyond the Mott limit
core_items.title_zh: 远超莫特极限的持久激子流体的电子结构
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.32437v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Excitons are conventionally expected to destabilize at high photoexcitation densities, as screening weakens the electron-hole attraction. Recent studies, however, challenge this paradigm, suggesting that excitons generated by strong optical pumping can remain stable even beyond the onset of population inversion. Here, using time- and angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy on 2D hybrid perovskites, we provide direct evidence for such a high-density excitonic state, characterized by a distinctive Mexican-hat dispersion. Remarkably, this excitonic band reconstruction endures for orders of magnitude longer than the optical coherence time, revealing a population-sustained electronic structure that survives well into the incoherent regime. The excitonic resonance also persists far beyond optical saturation, at densities where exciton wavefunctions strongly overlap. Our findings reveal a long-lived, high-density quantum fluid of excitons with characteristics reminiscent of a BCS condensate, an electronic structure markedly different from that of the dilute limit.
core_items.abstract_zh: 通常预计激子在高光激发密度下会不稳定，因为屏蔽削弱了电子空穴吸引力。然而，最近的研究挑战了这一范式，表明强光泵浦产生的激子即使在粒子数反转发生之后也可以保持稳定。在这里，我们利用二维杂化钙钛矿的时间和角度分辨光电子能谱，为这种高密度激子态提供了直接证据，其特征是独特的墨西哥帽色散。值得注意的是，这种激子带重建的持续时间比光学相干时间长几个数量级，揭示了一种群体维持的电子结构，该结构可以很好地适应非相干状态。在激子波函数强烈重叠的密度下，激子共振也持续远远超出光学饱和度。
